jobs.title: Relocation Project Coordinator
jobs.description:
At Cumming Group, you will work on some of the world's most exciting projects in a dynamic environment where your success is measured by the impact you make. We are one of the fastest-growing project and cost management consultancies in the United States, as reflected in our top 15 rankings in ENR. With over 70 offices globally, an extremely diverse project portfolio, and double-digit year-over-year revenue growth, the opportunities to make your mark are limitless!

  
  
  

We are currently hiring a Relocation Project Coordinator to work within our Education project sector in Los Angeles, CA. This role supports the relocation project team within a large community college school district and will support all FF&E activities and move management activities for multiple college campuses in the greater Los Angeles area.

  
  

**Essential Duties & Responsibilities:**

* Support the Furniture/Equipment/Relocation Project Management Services with emphasis in FF&E selection, procurement coordination and purchasing for all such areas as identified by the school district to provide the onsite FF&E and move-in/relocations management services. Responsibilities include strategic oversight of all FF&E procurement, FF&E Installation, Pre-move, Move, and Post move/Close-out phase activities for specified assigned projects. Services shall be provided at the direction of the College Project Director (CPD) and the Manager of Relocation Project Management team.
* Assist with the procurement and purchasing of FF&E using best-value and/or low bid public contracting.
* Support budget and schedule tracking efforts for FF&E and moves, and meet with relevant Project Architects (A/E), and Project Managers to be able to prepare office layouts and work with the occupants to plan furniture and equipment relocation of existing to the move location. Work with vendors and/or movers to assist with filling in equipment and furnishings where there are gaps.
* Coordinate and prepare a list of all new furniture and equipment needed for the project.
* Assist with the timely and successful onsite FF&E installation, punch-list sign-off and transition during swing space, relocation and/or move into new buildings.
* Support the procurement of specialty contractors or Movers for installations, delivery, and/or connections not covered by the FF&E vendors. Create detailed scope of work for Task Orders for Contractors/Movers as necessary.
* Support the Relocation PM in working with the Project Interior Designer and the building user groups to select and prepare a list of all furniture and equipment needed for the project.
* Assist in the onsite unlocking of all areas requiring access by the movers and others during the Pre-Move, Move, Installation and Post Move/Close-Out Phases and for the re-securing all such areas.
* Assist in the onsite coordination of all furniture and equipment deliveries with PMs, CPDs, Facility Directors, and BUGs if applicable; work closely with Asset Management Team to coordinate all asset tagging and disposition requirements, and Warranty Program Managers and other members of program staff working towards close-out of projects.
* Maintain all FF&E, move management, moving and storage related documents, including proposals, purchase orders, packing slips, time cards, shipping documents, freight bills, and invoices.
  

  

**Knowledge & Skills Required:**

* Ability to provide update and status reports for work in progress including cost and schedules.
* Experience with set-up and document control.
* Ability to read architectural and furniture drawing.
* Knowledge of furniture and equipment specifications and procurement.
* Knowledge of AutoCAD software.
* Strong written and oral communication, organizational, and interpersonal skills.
* Strong attention to detail.
* Ability to be onsite at multiple project sites. Flexibility in schedule and transportation to work at multiple locations based on assigned schedule.
  

  
  

**Preferred Education and Experience:**

* High School diploma required. Bachelor degree in Architecture, Interior Design, Interior Architecture, Construction Management, Facilities Management, or related field is preferred.
* A minimum of one (1) year of related experience in Interior Design, Construction, Engineering, Moves/Relocations, Facilities, or Furniture, Fixture and Equipment coordination/procurement.
* Procurement, sourcing, or asset management experience is preferred.
* Public works experience in preferred.
* Certification/Membership with CID, IIDA, AIA, IFMA, and LEED is preferred.

jobs.title: Asset/Move Coordinator I (Relocation Project Coordinator)
jobs.description:
**Job Description:**

**Join Our Team**

Project Support Services (PSS) is seeking an organized, detail-oriented Asset/Move Coordinator I to support the Los Angeles Community College District’s BuildLACCD program. This position assists with furniture, fixtures, and equipment (FF&E) coordination and campus relocations for new buildings, renovated facilities, and temporary swing spaces.

The ideal candidate brings experience in relocation coordination, interior design, construction, facilities, or FF&E procurement and enjoys coordinating the details that help campus teams move into functional, ready-to-use spaces.

**Position Overview**

Working with the Relocation Project Management (RPM) team, the Asset/Move Coordinator I supports FF&E planning, procurement, budget and schedule tracking, deliveries, installation, and move coordination across multiple LACCD campuses.

Under the direction of the College Project Director and RPM leadership, this position coordinates with campus representatives, project teams, designers, vendors, and movers throughout pre-move planning, installation, relocation, and closeout.

Assignments may include campuses within the Valleyside group—Los Angeles Valley College, Los Angeles Mission College, and Los Angeles Pierce College—and/or the Cityside group—Los Angeles City College, Los Angeles Trade-Technical College, and East Los Angeles College/South Gate. The position requires onsite availability, reliable transportation between assigned locations, and schedule flexibility.

**Key Responsibilities**

* Support FF&E selection, programming, specifications, procurement coordination, purchasing, and installation for new, renovated, and swing space projects.
* Assist with FF&E purchasing through best-value and/or low-bid public contracting processes.
* Coordinate with architects, interior designers, Project Managers, and campus user groups to identify furniture and equipment requirements.
* Assist with office layouts and plans for relocating existing furniture and equipment to new spaces.
* Prepare and maintain lists of new furniture and equipment needed for assigned projects, identifying gaps and coordinating with vendors or movers.
* Track FF&E and relocation budgets, schedules, purchases, deliveries, and installation activities.
* Support move planning, including scope development, bidding, bid analysis, scheduling, and onsite coordination.
* Prepare detailed scopes of work for task orders involving movers and specialty contractors supporting delivery, installation, or equipment connections.
* Coordinate furniture and equipment deliveries with project teams, campus facilities personnel, and building occupants.
* Assist with onsite FF&E installation, move oversight, punch list completion, and transition into occupied spaces.
* Coordinate access to project areas during pre-move, installation, move, and closeout activities, including unlocking and securing spaces as needed.
* Work with the Asset Management Team to coordinate asset tagging and disposition requirements.
* Coordinate with warranty personnel and other program staff to support project closeout.
* Maintain organized FF&E, moving, and storage records, including proposals, purchase orders, packing slips, time cards, shipping documents, freight bills, and invoices.

**Minimum Qualifications**

* At least one year of related experience in interior design, construction, engineering, moves/relocations, facilities, or FF&E coordination/procurement.
* High school diploma.
* Ability to read architectural and furniture drawings.
* Knowledge of furniture and equipment specifications and procurement.
* Strong written and verbal communication, organizational, and interpersonal skills.
* Strong attention to detail.
* Proficiency with Microsoft Office and related word processing, spreadsheet, and database software.
* Ability to work onsite at multiple colleges.
* Schedule flexibility and transportation to work at multiple locations based on project assignments.

**Preferred Qualifications**

* Four-year degree in Architecture, Interior Architecture, Interior Design, Construction/Project Management, Facilities Management, or a related field.
* Experience in procurement, sourcing, or asset management.
* Public works experience.
* Knowledge of or proficiency in AutoCAD.
* Relevant certification or professional membership associated with CID, IIDA, AIA, IFMA, or LEED.

**Apply**

Submit your resume highlighting your experience in FF&E coordination, procurement, facilities, or relocation projects, including any experience supporting educational facilities or public works programs.

Pay: $82,000.00 - $93,500.00 per year

Benefits:

* 401(k)
* Dental insurance
* Health insurance
* Life insurance
* Paid time off
* Vision insurance

Application Question(s):

* Do you have 1 year of related experience in Interior Design, Construction, Engineering, Moves/Relocations, Facilities, or Furniture, Fixture and Equipment coordination/procurement?
* Do you have a high school diploma?
* Do you have knowledge of furniture and equipment specifications and procurement, as well as the ability to read architectural and furniture drawings?
* Do you have public works experience?
* Do you have procurement, sourcing or asset management experience?
* Do you have certification/membership with CID, IIDA, AIA, IFMA, LEED?
* Do you have proficiency in Microsoft Office and related word processing, spreadsheet, and database software?
* Do you have a four-year degree in the areas of Architecture, Interior Architecture, Interior Design, Construction/Project Management, Facilities Management or related area required?

Ability to Commute:

* Los Angeles, CA 90017 (Required)

Work Location: In person

jobs.title: Social Media Coordinator
jobs.description:
**Position:** Social Media Coordinator

**Position Location:** New York, NY or Los Angeles, CA

**Start Date:** Immediate

**About:** The Premier Lacrosse League (PLL) is a professional lacrosse league in North America, composed of 8 teams rostered with the best players in the world. Co-founded by lacrosse superstar Paul Rabil and his brother, serial entrepreneur and investor, Mike Rabil, the Premier Lacrosse League is backed by an investment group composed of Joe Tsai Sports, The Raine Group, Creative Artists Agency (CAA), and other top investors in sports and media. The PLL is distributed through an exclusive media rights agreement with ABC, ESPN, ESPN2, and ESPN+. For more information, visit www.premierlacrosseleague.com and follow on social media: Instagram (@PLL), Twitter (@PremierLacrosse), Facebook (@PremierLacrosseLeague) and YouTube (YouTube.com/PLL).

**Company Values:**

* Stay Grounded
* Think Critically
* Be Helpful
* Encourage Creativity
* Persevere Through the Noise
* Operate Like an Owner

**Position Overview**:

The PLL is seeking a creative and strategic Social Media Coordinator who excels at building authentic connections with audiences across digital platforms. This role is responsible for developing engaging content, managing community interactions, and amplifying the PLL brand voice across all social channels.

The ideal candidate will serve as the digital voice for a PLL Team, creating thumb-stopping content that resonates with both lifelong lacrosse fans and newcomers to the sport. You'll collaborate with various departments of the league to develop compelling visual stories, timely reactive content, and innovative campaigns that drive engagement and grow our community.

This position requires a deep understanding of social media trends, platform-specific best practices, and the ability to adapt tone and style across multiple channels. You'll monitor the PLL online ecosystem, engage authentically with fans, handle community management, and identify opportunities to join relevant conversations that elevate the league's presence.

**Qualifications / Requirements:**

* Bachelor's degree preferred
* Minimum 3 years experience managing social media for a brand, sports team, or organization
* Portfolio demonstrating successful social media content and campaigns
* Strong proficiency across Instagram, TikTok, Twitter/X, Facebook, YouTube, and emerging platforms
* Basic video editing experience with Adobe Premiere Pro, Final Cut Pro, or similar tools
* Basic graphic design skills using Canva, Adobe Express, or similar platforms
* Exceptional copywriting abilities with platform-specific expertise and strong attention to detail
* Experience creating TikToks, Instagram Reels, Stories, and other short-form vertical content
* Deep knowledge of internet culture, memes, and social media trends
* Understanding of lacrosse (rules, players, teams) or strong willingness to learn quickly
* Passion for sports with ability to create content for both dedicated fans and casual audiences
* Self-motivated with excellent organizational, project management, and problem-solving skills
* Ability to thrive in a fast-paced environment, manage multiple priorities, and maintain composure under pressure
* Strong collaboration and communication skills with creative and cross-functional teams
* Ability to work a flexible schedule, including evenings and weekends, and travel for games and events as required by business needs, with or without reasonable accommodation

**Compensation:**

* $66,000-$72,000 annually
* Based on the candidate’s experience, seniority, and location
The total compensation package includes Annual Bonus, Health, Life, Dental, and Vision Insurance, 401(k) plan, Equity Sharing, Unlimited PTO, and Paid Parental Leave  

We are an equal opportunity employer and all qualified applicants will receive consideration for employment without regard to race, color, religion, national origin, sex, sexual orientation, age, disability, gender identity, marital or veteran status, or any other protected class.

jobs.title: Publicity Coordinator
jobs.description:
The Publicity Coordinator provides administrative and campaign support for the Publicity team, including: managing invoicing, purchase orders and department expenses; arranging talent travel and glam; maintaining and researching media lists and calendars; tracking press breaks and creating campaign reports; and maintaining press materials and assets on the press site.

  

***The hourly range for this job is between $21.01-$27.99 Hourly rate will take into consideration several factors including location.***

  

**KEY RESPONSIBILITIES**

* **Finance Admin:** Maintain invoicing process for the team, ensuring Purchase Orders are opened as needed and tracking invoicing through to payment. Working with the team’s Vice Presidents and Finance to track spending.
* **Travel and Glam Logistics:** Support talent travel and glam, working with talent reps, as well as the travel agency, car service and glam artists/their reps.
* **Press Materials and Assets:** Coordinate and help in drafting press materials, including weekly and monthly programming blasts, synopses, lead releases, cast bios and credits. Assist with digital asset selection and distribution. Work with publicists to keep present current for all campaigns.
* **Media Databases and Press Site Management:** Maintain and update media contact lists, editorial calendars, and press coverage reports. Track and compile daily media coverage in coordination with Corporate Communications. Press site management, working with the Publicity Manager and team publicist(s).
* **Administrative Support:** Additional administrative support including meeting coordination, including maintaining agendas and meeting notes. Process and track team purchase orders and invoices. Submit expense reports for the department Vice Presidents and others as needed.

  

**BASIC QUALIFICATIONS**

* Bachelor’s degree in Public Relations, Communications, Journalism, or comparable work experience.
* Strong judgment in maintaining confidentiality of unannounced projects, talent relationships and other sensitive and proprietary information.
* Proficiency in using Microsoft 365 (Word, Excel, Powerpoint, Sharepoint, etc.), Microsoft Teams and Zoom.
* Strong written and verbal communication skills.
* Highly organized with the ability to anticipate, prioritize and manage multiple projects and deadlines.
* Availability for some travel and after-hours support as-needed.

  

**PREFERRED QUALIFICATIONS**

* Experience using media databases (e.g., Muck Rack, Cision), press sites and release-distribution tools.
* Knowledge of the Hallmark brand and Hallmark Media platforms, or other family-friendly entertainment.
* Familiarity with entertainment media landscape and pop culture trends.

* Excellent organization, responsiveness, and follow-through.
* An interest in creator content, social platforms, brand partnerships, or production.

Los Angeles ONLY.

jobs.description:
**Job Overview**

FNTECH has been producing standout events since 1998, from global conferences and trade shows to hackathons, roadshows and leadership summits for both well-established and up-and-coming brands and companies. We’re a one-stop shop for Production, Event Management and Creative Design, and we bring the same drive for excellence and people-first approach to everything we do – our clients, our vendors and each other.

We are seeking an experienced Event Coordinator to support a team of four to six event managers in all aspects of Event Management. This role will have defined team responsibilities as well as growth opportunities, the option to impact company processes, to develop and maintain best practices, and support the development of our proprietary Show Management software system.

The ideal candidate is highly organized, deadline focused, and experienced in understanding complex planning. This person must be a confident and professional communicator who can interact effectively with internal teams and clients while maintaining strong collaboration with vendors, venue staff, and on-site operational teams. When things move fast, we’ll bring calm, not chaos.

This position requires the following skills and abilities:

● Excellent project management, organizational, and communication skills.

● Ability to manage multiple workstreams and complex timelines from start to finish.

● Understand how decisions relate to and affect various downstream event plans and activities.

● Flexibility to pivot quickly when ideas and plans change, which they always will.

● A thoughtful “solutions-first” mindset when challenges arise.

● Stay on schedule and meet established deadlines.

● Attention to detail that creates consistency between documents, software, and all communication tools.

● Striving for innovation and continuous quality improvement in processes, events, relationships, etc.

● Comfort working in various settings including the warehouse, office, offsite, office, show floor, etc. and in any weather conditions.

● Calm and composure under pressure during live production environments.

● Bonus: a creative and design-minded eye.

**KEY RESPONSIBILITIES**

**Department Support**

● Coordinate the ordering and management of company promotional products and branded apparel.

● Maintain inventory of branded assets.

● Support administrative functions that improve efficiency and organization including managing schedules and aligning priorities across projects, teams, and vendors.

● Support cross departmental collaboration with internal teams.

● Maintain stellar external relationships with vendors and production partners.

● Manage company’s Environmental inventory (see below for more details)

● Ensure the team's onsite event supply boxes are fully stocked as well as cross-referenced with specific orders and packing lists for each event.

**Environmental Inventory**

● Manage and maintain our Environmental (Furniture and Décor) department including lookbook, inventory, pricing, new purchases and warehousing.

● Partner with leadership and the Event Management team to plan and manage the Environmental inventory budget, and coordinate the purchasing, tracking and maintenance of related company assets.

● Work closely with the warehouse team on event deadlines pertaining to logistics, ensure information is being communicated between the Event Management Team and Warehouse.

● Ensure damaged items are repaired and graphics are removed prior to being stored.

● Continue to foster relationships with current vendors and discover new potential vendors.

**Specific Event Support**

Work closely with the Event Managers to:

● Act as the main liaison with venues to gather all guidelines and documentation, be the source of venue information for the internal team.

● Apply and obtain permits, submit COI requirements and venue orders, and cross-check against Proformas for company and client budgets.

● Schedule weekly meetings, gather and maintain agendas, keep meeting notes, review weekly deadlines, and organize notes for client and internal teams.

● Assist in managing logistics including workback plans, onsite production schedules, event agendas, shipping timelines, staffing schedules, and post event storage and product distribution.

● Support onsite event set-up and dismantle that may include specific activations, production office support, specific staffing areas, etc.

● Provide post-event feedback for venue, client and internal teams.

Additional Event Planning Team Support:

● Help identify and secure venues for clients by creating Requests for Proposals, managing and comparing responses, organizing site visits, and negotiating contracts.

● Assist in creating attendee journey mapping and space planning for every part of the program including main venue, ancillary and evening events, breakout functions, and offsite activities.

● Learn every part of the event lifecycle: catering, staffing, promo, registration, venue liaison, security, environmental, logistics, layouts, budget, attendee journey, graphics, workbacks & schedules, etc.

● The Event Coordinator and Sponsor & Logistics Coordinator work hand in hand, where each role strengthens the other to keep projects moving and on track.

● Travel to domestic and international shows as needed (valid passport required).

**Required Qualifications**

● Bachelor’s degree in Event Management, Marketing, Communications, or related field.

● 1-3+ years of experience in corporate or agency event management.

● Demonstrated team experience producing small to large-scale events, product launches, or technology industry events with a greater team.

● Strong client-facing experience with the ability to manage high-profile stakeholders.

● Experience with multiple communication technology and video conferencing platforms.

Pay: $60,000.00 - $80,000.00 per year

Benefits:

* 401(k)
* Dental insurance
* Employee assistance program
* Health insurance

jobs.description:
### **Description**

**THE PURPOSE:** The Social Media + Community Manager brings True Religion’s brand to life through compelling social content and meaningful community connections, both online and IRL. Reporting to the Director, Social Media, this role balances two equally important responsibilities: managing day-to-day social planning, content briefing, publishing, and performance reporting; and building an engaged community through conversation, relationship-building, and social listening. Working closely with the content creator and cross-functional partners, this person translates social strategy into a consistent, culturally relevant presence that grows awareness, engagement, advocacy, and traffic to TrueReligion.com and stores.

### **THE ROLE (what you are accountable for):**

**SOCIAL MEDIA MANAGEMENT**

* Own the day-to-day social content calendar, translating the Director’s strategy into monthly plans and weekly publishing schedules across Instagram, TikTok, and other priority channels. Balance campaigns, product storytelling, cultural moments, and community-led content.
* Manage scheduling and publishing across native platforms and social management tools. Coordinate assets, approvals, deadlines, and calendar changes with Creative, PR, Influencer Marketing, Ecommerce, and Retail partners.
* Develop clear content briefs for creative partners, outlining the objective, audience, key message, platform, format, hook, deliverables, and timing. Provide feedback and coordinate revisions to keep work on brief.
* Write and adapt captions, copy, calls to action, and platform-specific messaging in the brand voice. Check final assets, tags, links, product details, inventory, and approvals before publishing.
* Partner with the content creator on platform-native ideas, trend-driven content, and real-time coverage of launches and events
* Monitor post performance and recommend improvements to content mix, formats, hooks, posting cadence, and timing. Maintain an organized asset library and accurate calendar and publishing records.
* Deliver weekly social performance reporting, including reach, views, engagement rate, shares, saves, follower growth, and attributable traffic. Connect results to objectives, highlight top and underperforming content, and recommend specific actions and tests.

**COMMUNITY MANAGEMENT**

* Own daily community management across priority social channels, responding to comments, direct messages, mentions, and tags with timely, thoughtful, on-brand replies.
* Proactively join relevant conversations and engage with fans, creators, and cultural communities to strengthen relationships, encourage participation, and grow brand advocacy.
* Maintain community guidelines, response playbooks, and escalation workflows with the Director. Flag sensitive conversations and potential reputation issues promptly, coordinating responses with PR and Customer Service.
* Partner with Customer Service to optimize consumer journey across priority channels.
* Monitor brand and competitor conversations, audience sentiment, and fashion, music, and cultural trends. Turn recurring questions, feedback, and emerging conversations into content and campaign recommendations.
* Plan and execute community engagement initiatives, including prompts, polls, giveaways, challenges, and live conversations, coordinating approvals, logistics, and follow-up with relevant partners.
* Include community health in weekly reporting: sentiment, recurring questions, and engagement initiative results. Share actionable audience insights and track follow-through.

**YOU ARE:**

You are equal parts organized social operator and thoughtful community builder. You can turn a strategy into an actionable calendar, write a clear brief, and keep content moving from concept to publication. You understand how fashion, music, and culture intersect, bring a sharp instinct for brand voice, and know how to make audiences feel heard. You pair creative judgment with data, stay calm when conversations become sensitive, and take ownership of details, deadlines, and recommendations in a fast-paced environment.

  

### **REQUIRED MINIMUM EXPERIENCE**

  

* 3-5+ years of experience in social media management, including hands-on ownership of both content calendars/publishing and community engagement, ideally for a consumer brand
* Bachelor’s degree in Marketing, Communications, or a related field, or equivalent experience
* Deep knowledge of Instagram, TikTok, and other major social platforms, including platform-native storytelling, publishing workflows, and audience behavior
* Excellent writing and content briefing skills, with the ability to adapt brand voice across captions, creative briefs, and community conversations
* Experience managing comments, direct messages, and escalations, including handling negative feedback and sensitive issues with good judgment
* Hands-on experience with social media management and listening tools, such as Sprout Social, Hootsuite, or Brandwatch
* Strong analytical skills, with experience producing weekly social and community reports and translating performance data into clear recommendations
* Strong project management skills, with the ability to coordinate calendars, assets, approvals, and competing deadlines while responding to timely community needs

**PREFERRED EXPERIENCE:**

* Experience in fashion, apparel, or streetwear
* Experience collaborating with content creators, creative teams, and influencer programs, including sourcing UGC and coordinating usage permissions
* Basic photo and video editing skills, using tools such as CapCut, Canva, or Adobe Creative Suite

  

### **ADDITIONAL ROLE INFORMATION**

* Handle inbound and outbound calls with prospective customers.

* A strong work ethic and a high level of personal accountability.

* Strong time management, organization, and multitasking abilities.

jobs.description:
**Location:** Preferred on-site in Orange County, CA (Santa Ana office). We're also open to hybrid or remote candidates working on Pacific Time (PT).  
**Type:** Full-Time  
**Salary:** $75,000 – $90,000 base, depending on experience

### **About eJam**

eJam is a privately held consumer products company that has built, scaled, and exited multiple brands. Our portfolio includes category leaders ranked at the top of Amazon, carried in major retailers nationwide, and sold across DTC, marketplaces, and every channel in between.

We’re not a startup hoping something works. We’re a team that has done it repeatedly: taken products from idea to category leader, landed them on retail shelves nationwide, and built real brands that consumers love. We operate like a holding company with the speed of a startup: small teams with real ownership and accountability.

This is the place where you’ll see the entire machine: sourcing, product development, packaging, manufacturing, compliance, marketing, marketplace strategy, retail, all under one roof. If you want to build and ship consumer products at scale, there is no better place than this.

### **The Role**

You will own the path from a customer order to recognized, reconciled revenue across every eJam channel, end to end. Shopify, Amazon, TikTok Shop, QVC and retail each report revenue, refunds, fees and payouts differently, and you make them agree: one gross to net waterfall per brand, one daily revenue number the CEO, finance and media buyers all trust, and channel payouts that tie to the bank.

You will be the person who finds where the cash went missing, and the one who brings receivables management in house as we retire our outsourced A/R partner.

**Mission:** Finance and brand leadership know what we actually earned yesterday, by brand and channel, and every dollar between gross sales and the bank is explained, before they have to ask.

### **What You'll Own**

**Revenue data and reporting**

* Own the daily gross to net revenue report by brand and channel: gross sales, discounts, refunds, chargebacks, merchant and agency fees, sales tax and net revenue, and explain every movement
* Maintain the revenue layer of the BigQuery finance and goal pacing dashboards so the numbers the business runs on match what Accounting books
* Build and automate recurring revenue, subscription and channel performance reports, and replace manual spreadsheet pulls with repeatable queries
* Track subscription revenue health: rebill approval rates, declines, retries, churn and refund drivers, and flag what needs action

**Reconciliation and receivables**

* Reconcile Shopify, Amazon, TikTok Shop and payment processor payouts and settlements to the bank and the ledger each period, and chase every unexplained difference to its source
* Support the month end close with revenue, refund, chargeback and fee reconciliations, and the related journal entry support
* Manage retail and marketplace receivables (QVC, Target, Walmart, Kroger and the SAI portfolio as it moves in house): invoicing, remittance matching, deductions and short pays, and an aging the team acts on
* Own the sales tax data flow and marketplace facilitator treatment with our tax platform

**Process and systems**

* The order to cash process documented per channel, with control points and SOPs the team runs on, built with the data, subscription, customer support and media teams
* Recurring revenue reporting automated with Claude and documented so it survives a vacation

### **What Success Looks Like**

* **30 days:** the daily gross to net report publishes by brand without manual intervention and every channel's payout reconciliation is documented
* **90 days:** BigQuery revenue ties to QuickBooks Online for the prior month with a written bridge for every known difference, and retail and marketplace receivables aging is owned end to end
* **6 months:** order to cash SOPs exist for every channel, unreconciled revenue differences sit at zero at close, two recurring reports run materially faster, and the business trusts one revenue number

  
**Requirements**

**Required (all four, no exceptions)**

* **Order to cash:** tied Shopify, Amazon, TikTok Shop, Stripe or similar settlements and payouts back to the general ledger and found a gap
* **Gross to net:** built a bridge from gross sales through discounts, refunds, chargebacks, fees and tax to net revenue, and explained what moved
* **Subscription:** worked rebill approval, decline, retry and churn data for a recurring revenue business
* **Receivables:** managed retail or marketplace A/R, including remittance matching, deductions and short pays, with an aging someone acted on

**Also required**

* 3 to 7 years in revenue operations, revenue accounting or finance operations, ideally at a DTC, subscription or ecommerce brand
* Advanced Excel (pivots, lookups, Power Query) and working SQL, BigQuery or another warehouse preferred, with dashboards in Looker Studio, Tableau or Power BI
* You use AI, primarily Claude, as a working tool every day, and you check its output before it goes anywhere
* Bachelor's in finance, accounting, economics, analytics or related

**Nice to have**

* QuickBooks Online or Ramp
* A subscription or order management stack
* Sales tax and marketplace facilitator mechanics (TaxJar, Numeral or Avalara)
* Amazon settlement reporting

  
**Benefits**  

### **Compensation**

$75,000 to $90,000 base, depending on experience.

jobs.title: Project Coordinator
jobs.description:
Project Coordinator

**Company:** Componentry  
**Location:** Fremont, CA — fully onsite  
**Reports to:** President  
**Type:** Full-time, non-exempt, hourly  
**Schedule:** Monday–Friday, 8 a.m.–4:30 p.m., including a 30-minute unpaid meal break  
**Pay:** $28–$42 per hour, depending on relevant experience and demonstrated skills

About Componentry

Componentry helps hardware companies source and manage materials, build electronic and electromechanical assemblies, and keep production moving. We work as an extension of our customers’ teams, from quoting and procurement through production.

We’re looking for a Project Coordinator to connect the people, information, and actions needed to carry customer jobs from order review through delivery.

The role

You’ll maintain a clear picture of active jobs, follow up on commitments, identify risks, and coordinate solutions so work keeps moving.

Working directly with our President, you’ll partner with procurement, receiving, production, suppliers, and customers. You’ll track what has been purchased, what is outstanding, what is ready to kit or build, and what needs to happen to meet delivery commitments.

You’ll own the shared job dashboard and connect existing purchasing sheets, receiving records, and production schedules. Information should be accessible to the team without someone having to reconstruct a status report whenever an update is needed.

We’re open to training someone with strong organization, initiative, and follow-through. Your independence and decision-making authority will grow as you learn our business and demonstrate sound judgment.

What you’ll ownJob planning and visibility

* Review new orders against quoted lead times, checking material availability and production capacity with the team.
* Establish job milestones and flag conditions that could affect the expected schedule.
* Maintain the shared job dashboard, including purchasing progress, material delivery dates, receiving status, kit readiness, production, inspection, and shipment.
* Connect information across existing records and improve trackers and handoffs where needed.
* Keep blockers, next actions, owners, and deadlines visible.
* Establish regular updates with the team and escalate missing information or unresolved actions that put delivery at risk.
* Maintain traceability between customer jobs, purchase orders, and materials, including purchases supporting multiple jobs.

Follow-through and recovery

* Follow up with procurement on unpurchased items, supplier commitments, outstanding deliveries, and purchasing blockers.
* Follow up with receiving and production on discrepancies, kit completion, build progress, inspection, and rework.
* Identify stalled work, establish the next action with the responsible person, and follow through to resolution.
* Develop recovery plans with procurement and production, using their expertise to evaluate feasible options.
* Coordinate recovery actions and authorize expenses within established limits as responsibility grows.
* Escalate competing customer priorities, unresolved feasibility disagreements, and decisions outside your authority with options and a recommendation.
* Raise risks early enough for the team to respond.

Customer and supplier communication

* Confirm customer requirements, requested dates, and delivery arrangements.
* Obtain supplier shipment commitments, tracking information, and missing documents.
* Communicate job progress, outstanding dependencies, and schedule changes clearly.
* Work with the team and customer to agree on achievable recovery dates within established authority.
* Document commitments and confirm completion through customer delivery.
* Keep the President informed through frequent, concise updates and priority discussions.
* Clearly hand off unresolved issues requiring attention after your workday ends.

Project-related support

* Assist with sourcing, purchasing follow-ups, and documentation needed to move assigned jobs forward.
* Coordinate resolution of supplier account or administrative issues affecting project schedules.
* Take on other defined projects as agreed with the President, with priorities adjusted to match available capacity.

How responsibilities fit together

Procurement owns purchasing records and supplier purchasing activity. Receiving owns receiving records and material discrepancies. Production owns its schedule and execution.

You own the integrated job dashboard, cross-team follow-through, and coordination through customer delivery. You’ll work with these team members to identify risks, evaluate their recommendations, and drive next steps.

You’ll have the President’s backing to request timely updates, establish action deadlines with the team, and escalate unresolved commitments. Functional leads remain accountable for execution within their areas.

The President resolves competing customer priorities, significant escalations, and decisions beyond your authority. Customer delivery takes priority over additional internal projects.

What we’re looking for

* Evidence of taking responsibility and seeing work through completion.
* Strong organization across multiple tasks, deadlines, and changing priorities.
* Resourcefulness when information is missing or instructions are incomplete.
* Willingness to ask questions, learn from feedback, and apply what you learn.
* Confidence following up with experienced teammates, suppliers, and customers.
* Clear written and verbal communication.
* Attention to detail with dates, quantities, part numbers, documents, and records.
* Judgment about when to act, when to seek input, and when to escalate.
* Comfort working with spreadsheets, shared trackers, email, and business software.
* A collaborative approach and dependable follow-through without repeated reminders.

Relevant experience may come from project coordination, administration, purchasing, logistics, retail, hospitality, or other responsibilities requiring organization and owne

jobs.title: Operations Specialist - Office Coordinator
jobs.description:
**About the Team**
------------------

DoorDash Labs is an independent team within DoorDash. We explore robotics and automation to transform last mile logistics in the long term. If you want to work on commercializing autonomy and robotics in a service used by millions of people, then we want to talk to you!

**About the Role**
------------------

We're looking for an Operations Specialist - Office Coordinator to own how our DoorDash Labs sites run day to day and to follow every issue through to done. As the tier 2 layer between our front desk and procurement/inventory teams, you'll triage the request queue, run equipment transport, manage vendor and facilities follow-up, host visitors and events, and coordinate onboarding as the team grows.

You'll work closely with Front Desk, Procurement & Inventory, Workplace, Facilities, Finance, and engineering teams to keep our sites safe, organized, and ready as the team roughly doubles next year.

The Operations Specialist - Office Coordinator will report to the Supply Chain Lead.

**You're excited about this opportunity because you will…**
-----------------------------------------------------------

* Own the equipment transport queue (EOS / drones): set priorities, schedule pickups, track every request in Jira, and manage no-shows across sites
* Triage the daily request queue, making small calls independently and escalating larger decisions (e.g., security, construction, AV)
* Own tickets and follow-up with Workplace, landlords, and service vendors (cleaning, pest, dumpster, repairs, ServiceChannel), and maintain a weekly open-issues list
* Walk each site regularly (gate, dumpster, kitchen, restrooms, common areas), log issues, and track corrective work through completion
* Plan and run hosting: catering orders, demo-day logistics, visitor and event prep, rooms, and shuttles
* Own the new hire onboarding checklist (desk, badge, access, equipment, orientation) and track desk counts as the team grows
* Initiate site-level requests (e.g., furniture, desks, cabinets) and hand off to Procurement & Inventory for purchase
* Take over contractor contract renewals, contractor onboarding, and Coupa processes, including a backlog of contractors expiring at year end
* Partner with Front Desk, Procurement & Inventory, and Facilities to build repeatable playbooks that can be reused across sites

**We're excited about you because…**
------------------------------------

* You have 3+ years of experience in office management, facilities coordination, workplace operations, or operations coordination across one or more sites
* You are highly organized and own follow-through — nothing falls through the cracks until it is closed
* You have strong communication and interpersonal skills, and are comfortable managing vendors, landlords, and internal stakeholders
* You can juggle multiple priorities — transport requests, vendor follow-ups, events, and onboarding — in a fast-paced environment, including same-day requests
* You're comfortable with everyday operations and procurement systems (Google Workspace, Slack, Jira, Coupa, Brex, ServiceChannel, or similar)
* You bring sound judgment: you can make small calls independently and know when to escalate larger decisions
* You bring discretion and a customer-focused mindset to everything you do

**Nice to Have...**
-------------------

* Experience in a tech startup or fast-paced corporate environment
* Experience with Coupa, contractor onboarding, or contract renewals
* Experience supporting multi-site operations or new site openings
* Experience planning and running hosted events, demos, or catering
* Experience supporting hardware, robotics, or R&D teams with inventory or parts handling

We expect this position to be filled by 01-09-2027

**About DoorDash**
------------------

At DoorDash, our mission to empower local economies shapes how our team members move quickly, learn, and reiterate in order to make impactful decisions that display empathy for our range of users—from Dashers to merchant partners to consumers. We are a technology and logistics company that started by enabling door-to-door delivery, and we are looking for team members who can help us go from a company that is known as the place you order food to a company that people turn to for any and all goods.  
  
DoorDash is growing rapidly and changing constantly, which gives our team members the opportunity to share their unique perspectives, solve new challenges, and own their careers. We're committed to supporting employees' happiness, healthiness, and overall well-being by providing comprehensive benefits and perks including premium healthcare, wellness expense reimbursement, paid parental leave and more.

**Our Commitment to Diversity and Inclusion**
---------------------------------------------

We're committed to growing and empowering a more inclusive community within our company, industry, and cities. That's why we hire and cultivate diverse teams of people from all backgrounds, experiences, and perspectives. We believe that true innovation happens when everyone has room at the table and the tools, resources, and opportunity to excel.

You will be working on a special event under the guidance of the Shift Supervisors and Area Managers for one of our top clients. In this role, you will perform a variety of tasks, including but not limited to: access control, employee and guest engagement and verification measures, customer service level support and assistance, active patrolling and monitoring of client facilities, and responding to medical and non-medical emergency events.
  
  
Additionally, you will be expected to keep detailed notes throughout any incident you are a part of and will be asked to compile these notes with your coworkers to create an incident report after the fact. You will serve as the commercial mastermind partnering with industry titans to align their business objectives and product design cycles with NI’s tools, services, and roadmap investments.
  
In this role, you will lead growth and Global strategy for a Strategic Semiconductor Accounts at the bleeding edge of consumer electronics & AI applications.

**In This Role, Your Responsibilities Will Be:**

* **Account Strategy & Execution:** Work with multiple internal and external stakeholders across functions and geographies to develop, own, and execute comprehensive account strategies.
* **Opportunity Identification:** Apply advanced sales prospecting, networking, and due diligence to identify high-impact business opportunities that drive substantial revenue impact for NI.
* **Relationship & Influence Management:** Constantly expand NI’s area of influence by engaging new groups and customer leadership. Manage, influence, and close sales opportunities by deeply understanding customer business, personal, and technical needs.
* **Value Realization:** Connect customer challenges to the distinct value NI provides through our technical systems, services, and partner ecosystem. Represent customer needs internally to drive NI's future investment and product directions.
* **Project & Deal Management:** Apply strong problem-solving and project management skills to drive progress on account strategies. Utilize negotiation skills to ensure favorable contractual terms and business outcomes for NI.

  

**Who You Are:**

* You are a highly motivated sales professional who thrives at the intersection of technology, business strategy, and customer success.
* You have a passion for building executive relationships, uncovering complex business challenges, and delivering solutions that create measurable customer and business value.
* You bring deep experience managing large, complex accounts within the Semiconductor, Test & Measurement, or broader high-tech ecosystem.
* You are comfortable navigating long sales cycles, influencing multiple stakeholders, and driving alignment across technical, commercial, and executive audiences.
* You excel in ambiguous environments and have demonstrated success leading cross-functional teams to achieve ambitious growth objectives.
Whether engaging engineering teams on technical architecture, collaborating with internal product and marketing organizations, or presenting strategy to senior executives, you communicate with confidence and credibility.

  

**For This Role, You Will Need:**

* Bachelor’s degree (or foreign equivalent) in Electronics Engineering, Computer Engineering, Mechanical Engineering, Computer Science, or a closely related technical field.
* A minimum of 10+ years of progressive experience in technical sales, marketing, or a Business-to-Business (B2B) Sales occupation within the Test & Measurement or Semiconductor industry.
* Your verified experience must include the following specific qualifications:
  + **10+ years** of progressive experience in technical sales or marketing roles managing complex accounts with long sales cycles.
  + **5+ years** of experience managing and executing large, complex accounts at both the tactical and strategic levels.
  + **5+ years** of experience selling in long sales cycles involving complex, custom engineering hardware and software solutions.
  + **5+ years** of experience selling Electronic Test & Measurement or Test Automation Tools to customers in high-tech industries (such as Semiconductor, Transportation, Consumer Electronics, or Healthcare).
  + **3+ years** of experience developing and maintaining executive-level relationships internally and externally.
  + **3+ years** of experience selling directly to engineering leadership, including the C-suite.
  Only U.S. Persons (U.S. citizens, lawful permanent residents, or protected individuals as defined by 22 CFR §120) may be considered.

  

**Preferred Qualifications That Set You Apart:**

* **Technical Background:** Bachelor’s degree in any Engineering Discipline (specifically Electronics, Computer, Mechanical, or Computer Science).
* **Industry Performance:** A demonstrated track record of delivering year-over-year revenue growth and managing enterprise customers within the Test & Measurement or Semiconductor market.
* **Leadership & Influence:** Proven experience leading cross-functional sales teams (sales, technical, marketing) and engaging senior customer leadership or C-suite executives.
* **Domain Expertise:** Familiarity with semiconductor validation and production environments, as well as automotive, aerospace, or advanced physics test methodologies.
* **NI Ecosystem Knowledge:** Working knowledge of Test and Measurement Instrumentation, including NI products such as LabVIEW, TestStand, PXI, and DAQ platforms.

jobs.description:
**About Curium**

Curium is the world’s largest nuclear medicine company with more than a century of industry experience. We develop, manufacture and distribute world-class radiopharmaceutical products to help patients around the globe. Our proven heritage combined with a pioneering approach are the hallmarks to deliver innovation, excellence and unparalleled service.

  

With manufacturing facilities across Europe and the United States, Curium delivers SPECT, PET and therapeutic radiopharmaceutical solutions for life-threatening diseases to over 14 million patients annually. The name ‘Curium’ honors the legacy of pioneering radioactive researchers Marie and Pierre Curie, after whom the radioactive element curium was named and emphasizes our focus on nuclear medicine. The tagline ‘Life Forward’ represents our commitment to securing a brighter future for all those we serve: An enhanced quality of care for our patients. A trusted partner to our customers. A supportive employer to our valued team.

  

**Summary of Position**
-----------------------

The Oncology/Nuclear Medicine Account Manager will be responsible for developing and implementing a business plan for their assigned territory. Primary responsibilities will include driving sales of approved products, developing long‐term business relationships with Key Opinion Leaders (KOLs) and other important decision makers in hospitals, cancer centers and physician offices, educating customers on Curium products, executing Marketing plans and establishing contracts with accounts. The Oncology/Nuclear Medicine Account Manager will collaborate cross-functionally with Sales, Marketing, Customer Service, Medical Affairs, Legal and other stakeholders to ensure territory goals are aligned and achieved. This position will also require participation in local, regional or national medical meetings (in the areas of Oncology, Gastroenterology, Radiology, Nuclear Medicine and others) as assigned by the Regional Sales Manager.

**Essential Functions**
-----------------------

* Successfully manage the selling process in all assigned call points (which may include Physicians, Nurses, Nuclear Medicine Technologists, Radiation Safety Officers, Pharmacists, Department Managers, Procurement, Reimbursement Specialists, etc.).
* Successfully advocate for new Curium product additions to hospital formulary committees within assigned institutions.
* Meet or exceed Sales targets for all products within an assigned territory.
* Develop and execute growth‐centered business plans.

* Manage communications to ensure territory success and customer satisfaction.
* Utilize all available resources in an efficient, cost effective manner to optimize the Sales process (Marketing programs, tools, personnel, clinical support, training).
* Educate customers on product features, benefits and applications within guidelines.

* Effectively pull through managed care opportunities to drive sales.
* Manage expense budget for assigned territory.
* Adhere to all company financial, administrative and ethical guidelines.
* Travel beyond territory boundaries to assist with Sales and customer education efforts.
* Perform additional duties as assigned by management.
* Must maintain operational compliance with US and international regulatory agencies and guidelines (i.e. FDA, EU, HC, TGA, PIC/S, ISO, USP, NRC, cGMP, etc.).

**Requirements**

* Thorough understanding of selling, negotiation and customer service skills.
* Proven success selling in a managed care environment.
* Excellent verbal and written communication skills.
* Ability to understand and manage financial solutions.
* Excellent analytical and problem‐solving skills.
* Strong computer expertise and business application preferred.
* Excellent time management and prioritization skills.

This is a field based Sales/Account Management position requiring frequent travel, including some weekends, within an assigned territory.

Curium is an equal opportunity employer and believes everyone deserves respect, dignity and equality. All applicants will be considered for employment without attention to race, color, religion, sex, sexual orientation, gender identity, national origin, veteran or disability status.

jobs.title: Executive Assistant & Business Partner to the CEO
jobs.description:
**Executive Assistant & Business Partner to the CEO — (San Francisco, CA)**

**Full-time | In-person | 5+ years of relevant experience required**

**FurtherAI** is building the AI Workspace for Insurance, empowering underwriters, brokers, and carriers to automate routine work so they can focus on higher-value decisions. We move fast, prioritize clarity and quality, and value effective, high-integrity work.

**The role**
------------

This is not a traditional EA job. You'll be the CEO's right hand: part Executive Assistant, part Executive Business Partner, and the owner of how it feels to work at FurtherAI day to day.

You'll own the CEO's time, priorities, and follow-through end to end, so the most important work keeps moving and nothing falls between conversations. You'll also build the workplace experience from the ground up: our office, our rituals, our offsites, and the small details that make a fast-growing team feel like a team.

The best person for this role acts as a force multiplier. You anticipate needs before they're voiced, reduce the CEO's cognitive load, and bring the judgment to decide what deserves attention and what doesn't. As we scale, this role grows with you.

**What you'll do**
------------------

### **Run the CEO's time and attention**

* Own the CEO's calendar end to end: sequence priorities, protect focus time, anticipate conflicts, and decide what truly needs their time.
* Triage the CEO's inbox, surface what matters, and draft clear, thoughtful replies on their behalf.
* Coordinate complex scheduling across customers, investors, candidates, press, and the internal team.
* Plan travel and logistics end to end, with the right prep and follow-through built in.
* Handle occasional personal logistics (appointments, vendors, travel) with discretion and sound judgment.

### **Be a true business partner**

* Make sure the CEO walks into every key meeting prepared: agendas, pre-reads, context, and who's in the room.
* Capture decisions and action items, then drive follow-through so nothing important gets lost.
* Build and run a lightweight operating system for priorities, open loops, and commitments.
* Own logistics and prep for board meetings, investor updates, and leadership syncs.
* Take on special projects with the CEO and leadership team: research, process improvements, and cross-functional initiatives.

### **Own the workplace experience**

* Run the San Francisco office: space, vendors, supplies, food, and making sure it works for the team every day.
* Plan team offsites, all-hands, celebrations, and customer or candidate events.
* Partner with Recruiting and People on onboarding, so every new hire feels welcome and productive from day one.
* Shape and scale our culture through rituals, engagement initiatives, and internal communications.
* Build the processes and documentation that help the office and team run smoothly as we grow across locations.

**What success looks like**
---------------------------

* **First 30 days:** You know the CEO's priorities, working style, and key relationships. Their calendar and inbox run smoothly, and you've got a handle on how the office runs today.
* **First 90 days:** You're trusted to make calls on the CEO's behalf. You've built the operating rhythm for meeting prep and follow-through, and you've run your first offsite or company event.
* **First year:** The CEO spends more of their time on the highest-impact work because of you. The workplace experience is something candidates notice and the team is proud of.

**About you**
-------------

* 5 to 8+ years supporting a founder, CEO, or C-suite leader, ideally at a fast-growing startup.
* Experience owning office or workplace operations, events, or team culture programs.
* Excellent judgment and discretion, with a track record of handling confidential information.
* Highly organized and detail-oriented without losing speed. You build structure where there is none.
* A clear, warm communicator who adapts to different styles and builds trust across every team.
* You anticipate needs, spot issues early, and fix them without being asked.
* Calm and effective in a high-stakes, fast-changing environment.
* Fluent in modern tools: Google Workspace, Slack, Notion, and AI assistants like Claude or ChatGPT.
* Based in San Francisco and excited to be in the office 5 days a week.
* Bonus: experience at an AI or B2B SaaS company.

### **This role is not for you if**

* You prefer a rigid, predictable, or slow-moving environment.
* You want to manage rather than roll up your sleeves and do.
* You're not excited about high ownership and hands-on execution.
* You can't work in person in San Francisco.
* Work/life balance is important to you

**Why Join FurtherAI:**

* Partner closely with founders/leadership at a fast-growing AI company
* Gain exposure and responsibility across all aspects of early-stage operations
* Help shape culture and foundational processes
* Receive competitive salary, equity, and benefits
* Join a team that values speed, communication, and craftsmanship

**You can look forward to the following benefits:**

* Fully covered, best-in-class health, dental, and vision benefits
* Competitive Compensation, meaningful stock options, company 401(k)
* Unlimited PTO
* Outstanding in-office culture in the heart of San Francisco
* Lunch and dinner onsite
* Team events, such as happy hours and off-sites
* Commuter benefits

Compensation Range: $140K - $165K

**Job Title:** Nest and Nourish Program Coordinator
  
**Department:** Food Access Unit

**Bureau:** Bureau of Brooklyn Neighborhood Health
  
**Location:** 485 Throop Avenue, Brooklyn

**Schedule & Hours:** 8-4, 830-430, or 9-5; M-F
  
**Workplace Flexibility Modality:** Hybrid (up to 2 days per week remote)
  
**Work Environment:** Office Environment
  
**Grant End Date:** 09/29/2027
  
**Created Date:** 10/22/2026
  
**Revised Date:** 11/5/2026
  
**Salary:** $72,000
  
**FLSA Classification:** Non - Exempt
  
Who We Are
  
The Fund for Public Health in New York City (FPHNYC) is a 501(c)3 non-profit organization that is dedicated to the advancement of the health and well-being of all New Yorkers. To this end, in partnership with the New York City Department of Health and Mental Hygiene (DOHMH), FPHNYC incubates innovative public health initiatives implemented by DOHMH to advance community health throughout the city. It facilitates partnerships, often new and unconventional, between government and the private sector to develop, test, and launch new initiatives. These collaborations speed the execution of demonstration projects, effect expansion of successful pilot programs, and support rapid implementation to meet the public health needs of individuals, families, and communities across New York City.
  
  
Our Culture
  
We embrace a culture of learning, collaboration, innovation, and well-being, where open communication drives our impact.
  
About The Role
  
The Program Coordinator will support the day-to-day implementation of the Nest and Nourish program, a HRSA-funded prescription produce program for pregnant and postpartum individuals. The position will serve as a primary point of contact for participants, including coordinating enrollment, navigation, referrals, follow-up, data collection, and retention activities. The coordinator will work closely with clinical partners, community-based organizations, program staff, and program leadership to ensure effective implementation of the program.
  
About the Program
  
Nest & Nourish is a program of the NYC Department of Health and Mental Hygiene’s Bureau of Brooklyn Neighborhood Health that aims to improve maternal health by increasing food access and security among pregnant and postpartum participants. The program provides produce benefits, nutrition education, case management, and connections to community resources. This program is one of several food access initiatives in the Bureau of Brooklyn Neighborhood Health.
  
  
Responsibilities
  

* Coordinate participant recruitment, eligibility screening, enrollment, and orientation to services.
* Serve as a primary point of contact for participants during program engagement.
* Conduct regular participants check-ins and assess food access, social needs, and barriers to participation.
* Coordinate distribution and tracking of monthly benefits.
* Monitor participant engagement, voucher redemption, nutrition education participation, and retention. Provide referrals and navigation assistance to other bureau programs and community resource activities.
* Coordinate required nutrition education classes, cooking demonstrations, and other program activities.
* Conduct reminder and re-engagement outreach for participants who miss appointments or program activities.
* Maintain accurate and timely participant records in accordance with program and privacy requirements.
* Collect survey data and other program evaluation data and support monitoring of data quality.
* Support program outreach, community engagement, and recruitment events.
* Prepare routine program updates and identify participants’ needs, barriers, and opportunities for improvement.
* Support grant deliverables, reporting, and program implantation activities.

Requirements
  

* A baccalaureate degree from an accredited college and two years of experience in community work or community centered activities in an area related to the duties described above; or
* High school graduation or equivalent and six years of experience in community work or community centered activities in an area related to the duties as described above; or
* Education and/or experience which is equivalent to "1" or "2" above. However, all candidates must have at least one year of experience as described in "1" above.
* Strong attention to detail and consistent follow-through.
* Excellent organizational skills and highly detailed oriented
* Excellent oral and written communication skills
* Demonstrated ability to effectively establish and maintain working relationships with culturally diverse community groups.
* Bilingual (written and spoken) Spanish language proficiency preferred.
* Physical Requirements: Ability to stand for extended periods of time. Reasonable accommodations will be made for qualified individuals with disabilities.

Employment is contingent upon the successful completion of a background check

* A retirement savings plan with generous employer contribution

jobs.title: Marketing Coordinator, Lifecycle Marketing
jobs.description:
**Position summary**

The Marketing Team at MoMA brings together specialists in Marketing and channel strategies, content and audience development, driven by finding new ways to bring the Museum’s mission and brand positioning to life and by building meaningful relationships with new and existing priority audiences for the institution. This work supports the financial sustainability of MoMA by strengthening the Museum's earned revenue streams.

Reporting to the Senior Marketing Manager, Paid Media, the Lifecycle Marketing Coordinator is the hands-on owner of MoMA's lifecycle and owned-channel retention programs. The role builds, tests, and optimizes email, segmentation, automation, website and landing page experiences, and visibility in search and AI-driven discovery. The focus is the mid- and low-funnel: moving audiences from consideration to visit, ticket purchase, membership, and repeat engagement.

The Coordinator works in alignment with Paid Media so that acquisition and retention operate as one connected customer journey. The Senior Marketing Manager sets channel strategy and priorities; the Coordinator executes, experiments, and reports on results.

**Responsibilities:**

* Lifecycle program ownership
* + Builds and runs always-on lifecycle programs across the customer journey: welcome, pre-visit, post-visit, membership acquisition, and lapsed-user reactivation.
  + Maintains the lifecycle roadmap and the content calendar.
  + Sets success metrics for each program with the Senior Marketing Manager, such as conversion to visit, membership conversion rate, repeat visit rate, and revenue per send.

* CRM and email execution
* + Builds, QA, and sends email campaigns and automated journeys in Klaviyo.
  + Manages list health, deliverability, consent, and compliance.
  + Maintains the newsletter program with Design and Content teams: templates, content planning, and send cadence.
  + Runs documented testing programs across email, journeys, and landing pages; log hypotheses and results, and positive learnings.

* Segmentation and audience data
* + Builds and maintains audience segments with Analytics and Data teams, and applies behavioral signals to the overall strategy.
  + Keeps CRM data inputs, integrations, and tagging accurate and documented.

* Landing page and conversion optimization
* + Plans, builds, and optimizes landing pages for tickets, membership, exhibitions, programs, and events.
  + Owns conversion optimization for mid- and low-funnel pages, working with Digital Product, Design, and Content on templates and tracking.

* Search and AI-driven discovery
* + Optimizes owned content for organic search and AI platforms: structured data, prompts, content structure, and accuracy of MoMA information.
  + Uses Profound to monitor and report on MoMA's visibility in AI search results and recommend and implement fixes.

* Agency relationship, reporting and analysis
* + Builds dashboards and recurring reports in Heap and Google Analytics on lifecycle KPIs and gives data-backed recommendations to the Senior Marketing Manager and Marketing leadership.
  + Partners with the Membership team to support membership conversion goals and develops funnel strategies that improve join, upgrade, and renewal rates.
  + Aligns lifecycle messaging with Ticketing, Visitor Experience, Development, Retail, Editorial, Design, Digital Product, and Analytics.
  + Coordinates with Paid Media Sr. Manager and the agency on audience syncs, retargeting lists, creative handoffs, and paid search and landing page message alignment. Manages Klaviyo and other platform vendors day-to-day.

**Requirements:**

* Bachelor’s degree and at least three years of hands-on lifecycle, CRM, or retention marketing experience, including expert-level execution in Klaviyo.
* Proficiency in Heap and Google Analytics (GA4): tracking, funnel and cohort analysis, conversion reporting, and attribution. Ability to define KPIs and explain results and next steps to stakeholders.
* Expert knowledge of agentic and AI search visibility, with hands-on experience in Profound, plus working knowledge of SEO
* Ability to build audiences, journeys, and content without engineering support. Working knowledge of HTML/CSS for email and SQL or equivalent for segmentation.
* Track record of A/B tests that changed program decisions, and of optimizing landing pages and conversion paths in a CMS.
* Knowledge of email deliverability, consent, and privacy compliance requirements.
* Clear written communication, attention to detail, and the ability to manage multiple deadlines across teams.

**Reports to:** Senior Marketing Manager, Paid Media

**Salary:** The salary for this position is $68,190 per annum.

jobs.description:
**Who We Are**
==============

Serval is the AI-native enterprise service management platform that automates the work legacy IT service management tools only track. Our AI agents build the automations that power employee support, then resolve requests against them instantly—helping teams across IT, HR, finance, legal, and beyond automate work within one governed platform.

Companies including Fox, Live Nation, Notion, Ramp, and Lucid Motors run on Serval. Headquartered in San Francisco, we’ve raised $277 million from investors including Sequoia Capital, Redpoint Ventures, First Round, General Catalyst, and Elad Gil, most recently a $150 million Series C at a $3 billion valuation.

We’re building a team that moves quickly, takes ownership, and wants to make a meaningful impact on how the world’s largest organizations work. Come help us build what’s next for enterprise service management.

**About The Role**
------------------

The Content Marketing Manager owns the content engine that turns Serval's point of view into pipeline. You will plan, write, and ship the stories, customer narratives, and campaigns that reach CIOs and IT leaders, and make sure each piece earns its place in the funnel.  
This is a builder role on a small, fast team. You will write a lot yourself, set the editorial bar, and partner closely with brand, product marketing, demand gen, and sales. You report to Alana O'Grady.

**What you'll do**

* Comfort using AI tools in your writing workflow while keeping the output unmistakably human.

-----------------

jobs.title: Enterprise Customer Success Manager (US)
jobs.description:
Easol is the leading all-in-one ‘experience commerce’ platform built to power experience businesses including festivals, wellness retreats, food and drink, sports and adventure trips. With Easol, experience businesses have complete control to drive more direct sales, retain more revenue, own their data and run their business on their terms.

Easol has deep roots in experiences. The platform was founded by former festival founders, Lisa and Ben Simpson in 2017, after the husband and wife team endured challenges and frustrations first-hand while setting up and growing their own experience business including Rise, Europe’s biggest Snowsports and music festival, and Beyond Adventures, a series of adventure travel experiences in remote locations such as the Sahara desert and the Swedish archipelago.

Easol is the first AI operating system for the Experience Commerce category - an intelligent digital workforce that helps experience creators run their business. Our ambition is bold: to become the category leader in a $300bn+ space.

We power professional experience creators with a fully integrated platform that brings together website, booking engine, payments, sales & marketing tools, operations, and data & insight - all underpinned by agentic AI. Easol enables enterprise creators to streamline, scale and transform their businesses through a single, end-to-end system.

Success in this role means your creators are successfully launched, retained, actively using Easol and view you as a trusted strategic partner who understands both their business and the platform.

### **Responsibilities & Duties**

* Partner closely with Product, Engineering, Solutions and Event Operations to resolve complex issues, providing clear context, coordinating specialist support and driving issues through to resolution.
* Act as the voice of the creator internally, translating feedback, operational challenges and business requirements into actionable product insights that help influence priorities and shape Easol's roadmap.
* Maintain strong product knowledge and advise creators on how to best use Easol's capabilities to improve their customer experience and operational performance.
* Represent Easol onsite at key creator events, launches and strategic meetings to strengthen relationships and support successful delivery.
* Contribute to the continued development of Easol's Customer Success approach, including account planning, processes, tooling, automation and scalable ways of working.

### **Requirements**

* **4+ years of experience** in Customer Success or Account Management within SaaS/B2B, with demonstrated experience independently owning and managing a portfolio of customers, including responsibility for account health, retention and long-term success.
* Experience leading complex implementations, launches or customer projects involving multiple internal and external stakeholders.

jobs.title: Revenue Operations Manager

**Treasure AI:**

Treasure AI is the agentic experience platform built to acquire, retain, and grow your most valuable customers. Powered by AI, Treasure AI is shaped by human creativity and always-on through continuous, context-driven action.

Furthermore, Treasure AI employees are enthusiastic, data-driven, and customer-obsessed. We are a team of drivers—self-starters who take initiative, anticipate needs, and proactively jump in to solve problems. Our actions reflect our values of honesty, reliability, openness, and humility.

You will own the operational backbone that keeps both functions running with precision: data quality, process standardization, performance reporting, health and renewal analytics, and the systems and tooling that underpin daily execution.

=========================

New York City area
  
Full-time

$72,000–$82,000 annually, depending on experience

**Your first 90 days:** This is a regular full-time position. We set clear goals and review progress together, with check-ins at 30, 60, and 90 days.

**About CyberGuy**
------------------

CyberGuy delivers award-winning technology reporting, reviews, and practical advice across television, digital, social media, newsletters, podcasts, and live classes. Our mission is to help people make smarter tech decisions and protect their privacy, security, and safety.

We’re a small, collaborative team where your ideas and execution have a visible impact. We value initiative, accuracy, clear communication, and thoughtful work.

**What You’ll Do**
------------------

* **Create original video.** Develop, shoot, and edit demonstrations, interviews, explainers, and behind-the-scenes stories with Kurt in NYC. Adapt television and podcast material into engaging social content.

* **Keep production moving.** Maintain the content calendar, coordinate assets and approvals, and prepare for shoots with the information and materials needed to execute well.
* **Turn results into better content.** Track retention, watch time, engagement, clicks, and conversions where measurable. Test ideas and recommend specific improvements.
* **Support paid campaigns.** Help launch, monitor, and optimize Facebook, Instagram, and other relevant advertising campaigns.
* **Stay connected to our audience.** Follow CyberGuy’s reporting and audience conversations, monitor comments, and bring forward timely ideas that fit our voice and mission.

You’ll work closely with the SVP Digital on strategy, creative direction, campaigns, and audience growth.

**What You Bring**
------------------

* At least two years of relevant experience in social media, filmmaking, journalism, or digital content production.
* A strong portfolio demonstrating storytelling, shooting, editing, and social copywriting, especially for vertical video.
* Proficiency with tools such as Adobe Premiere, CapCut, Canva, or comparable software.
* Experience managing social channels, content calendars, publishing tools, and competing deadlines.
* Hands-on experience with Meta Ads Manager and an understanding of social analytics.
* An interest in consumer technology and the ability to make complicated topics clear and engaging.
* Excellent attention to detail, reliable follow-through, and the judgment to ask questions early and solve problems independently.

Experience with WordPress, affiliate marketing, TikTok Shop, or additional advertising platforms is a plus.

**Benefits**
------------
