PC1 leverages Pfizer’s manufacturing, science, and technology capabilities to support biopharmaceutical partners through custom API synthesis, sterile injectable fill‑finish, and highly potent oral solid dose manufacturing.

The Commercial Development & Marketing Associate supports a variety of activities across Pfizer CentreOne's inside sales and marketing functions. The role assists with the timely follow-up of marketing-qualified leads through established CRM processes, applying defined guidelines to help review, route, and document lead activity. The Associate also supports marketing projects, content development, and campaign activities while continuing to build commercial knowledge and experience.

This position provides opportunities to develop an understanding of Pfizer CentreOne's commercial model through hands-on experience, cross-functional exposure, mentorship, and team collaboration. The Associate will build knowledge of how Marketing, Inside Sales, and Business Development work together to support demand generation and pipeline development, while contributing to day-to-day inside sales activities and marketing initiatives.

**Inside Sales Lead Follow-Up**

* Monitor & review new marketing-qualified leads daily in Salesforce across the drug product and drug substance queues, and route ABM leads to the responsible BD team member

**Marketing Project Support**

* Assist with maintaining organized lead, campaign, and reporting documentation in Salesforce, Teams, and SharePoint

**Team & Meeting Support**

* Support preparation and logistics for conventions, internal meetings, BD/Marketing team syncs, and selected customer-facing interactions
* Coordinate meeting materials, capture action items, and support follow-up tracking for the BD and Marketing teams
* Respond to routine inside sales and marketing operational inquiries and support appropriate follow-up activities in accordance with established processes and guidance.

**Commercial Capability Development**

* Learn and apply knowledge of PC1's business model, buyer personas, and lead lifecycle to support effective support management and commercial engagement.
* Gain exposure to lead generation, inside sales, Business Development, and Marketing to effectively support collaboration across PC1's commercial organization.

**BASIC QUALIFICATIONS**

**PREFERRED QUALIFICATIONS**

* Willingness and ability to learn new systems and processes quickly

jobs.title: Executive Assistant & Operations Associate
jobs.description:
**About Us**
------------

Nidus is building autonomous manufacturing systems powered by AI and robotics. U.S. manufacturers are under growing pressure to increase output while navigating workforce constraints, underutilized equipment, and increasingly complex supply chains. We believe the next generation of manufacturing will be enabled by more intelligent, flexible automation—systems that help people and machines work together to expand capacity and improve productivity.

We're building the intelligence layer that makes that possible.

Our team comes from the intersection of defense technology and AI. We've built and shipped products to DoD customers, and we bring deep experience across ML, robotics, product development, and defense.

We're a small, in-person team in New York City working on hard problems that matter. If you want to build the future of American manufacturing, we'd love to hear from you.

**The role**
------------

We’re hiring an Executive Assistant & Operations Associate to be the right hand to our CEO and founders. You’ll keep the company moving at full speed. The founders’ time is the scarcest resource we have, and your job is to protect it, multiply it, and make sure every customer, candidate and guest leaves wanting to work with Nidus.

Every hour you give back goes into winning customers, hiring exceptional talent and building the company. You’ll work in person with a small, senior team that moves fast, and you’ll have a front-row seat to how a defense tech company gets built.

**What you’ll do**
------------------

* Run the founders’ calendars and travel. Keep schedules tight, trips smooth and plans ready to change at a moment’s notice, including for anyone traveling with them.
* Own expenses end to end. Close out receipts, expense reports and reimbursements before anyone thinks to ask.
* Move deals forward. Coordinate NDAs, calls and meetings at Nidus and at customer sites. Draft and send emails, and chase every follow-up until it’s done.
* Help us win great people. Partner with the Head of Talent on candidate meetings with the founders, including scheduling, travel and onsite visits.
* Bring people together. Plan NYC recruiting dinners and events with the Head of Talent, and help organize offsites and team outings that people look forward to.
* Keep the office running. Handle visitor access, deliveries and packages so the team can stay focused on building. Welcome guests, prepare for visits, and make sure every customer and partner who walks in remembers us.

**Who you are**
---------------

* You’ve supported founders or executives, and you’ve made them measurably more effective.
* You see what’s coming before anyone asks, fix conflicts quietly, and close loops without reminders.
* You’re organized, responsive and reliable. When you say something is handled, it is.
* You write clearly and represent the company with confidence to anyone, from a government customer to a senior engineering candidate.
* You’re discreet. You’ll see sensitive information and treat it that way.
* You want to work in person with a small team that moves fast, and the pace energizes you.
* Bonus: experience in defense tech or working directly with government customers.

**Compensation & Benefits**
---------------------------

Base Salary: 100k - 150k.

The listed range reflects base salary only. Total compensation also includes meaningful equity and benefits:

* **Equity:** Meaningful ownership in what we’re building.
* **Health coverage:** Medical, dental and vision through Thatch.
* **Team lunches:** Lunch in the office with the team.

Our benefits will keep growing as we do. If the work excites you, please apply. We’d love to talk!

Nidus Technologies is an equal opportunity employer, and qualified applicants will receive consideration for employment without regard to race, color, religion, sex, sexual orientation, gender perception or identity, national origin, age, marital status, protected veteran status, or disability status.

We encourage candidates from all backgrounds to apply, even if you don't feel like you're a perfect fit. If you're passionate about contributing to our mission, we'd love to hear from you!

jobs.title: Executive Assistant, CHRO

Responsibilities:

Related is seeking a polished, proactive, and highly organized Executive Assistant to support the Chief Human Resources Officer (CHRO). The primary focus of this role is providing exceptional executive support through proactive calendar and priority management, sound judgement, and seamless coordination of the CHRO’s day-to-day responsibilities. This role will also contribute to executive communications, document development, and project coordination, providing critical support to the CHRO and broader HR leadership team.

Based on site at 30 Hudson Yards, this individual will work closely with the CHRO on key priorities and initiatives impacting Related's people, culture, and talent strategy. The ideal candidate is a forward-thinking problem solver who can anticipate needs, manage competing priorities, exercise sound judgment, and bring structure and accountability to a fast-paced executive office.

Responsibilities include, but are not limited to:

**Executive Support**

* Own and strategically manage the CHRO’s calendar, serving as a gatekeeper for competing priorities, evaluating meeting requests based on urgency and importance, and proactively protecting time for critical business priorities.
* Take end-to-end ownership of assigned responsibilities, ensuring all related details, dependencies, and follow-up actions are addressed without requiring ongoing direction.
* Prepare the CHRO for upcoming meetings by developing agendas, gathering materials, coordinating with stakeholders, and ensuring key information is readily available.
* Establish a regular planning cadence with the CHRO to review upcoming commitments, align on priorities, and ensure adequate preparation for the week ahead.
* Serve as a primary point of contact for internal and external stakeholders, managing communications and ensuring timely follow-up.
* Help manage the intersection of professional and personal commitments, anticipating scheduling conflicts and ensuring thoughtful coordination of priorities.

**Communications & Document Development**

* Draft, edit, and proofread internal announcements, communications, talking points, and other materials on behalf of the CHRO.
* Prepare presentations, executive summaries, meeting notes, and briefing materials for HR leadership meetings and broader company initiatives.
* Maintain rolling agendas and action-item trackers to document key decisions, establish ownership, and ensure follow-through.
* Assist with gathering and synthesizing information from internal surveys, employee feedback, and other HR initiatives, translating findings into organized summaries and actionable insights.

**Project & Department Coordination**

* Support the coordination and execution of key HR projects and enterprise-wide initiatives, tracking milestones, deliverables, and deadlines.
* Proactively follow up with stakeholders to collect materials, monitor progress, and keep projects moving forward.
* Coordinate cross-functional meetings and initiatives involving HR leadership and other departments across Related.
* Assist with planning and executing HR department events, leadership gatherings, employee engagement activities, and company celebrations.
* Identify opportunities to improve administrative processes and leverage emerging technologies, including AI tools such as ChatGPT and Claude, to enhance efficiency and productivity.

Qualifications:

* 5 + years of executive level support, ideally within a corporate, financial services, real estate, or similarly fast-paced environment.
* Experience supporting strategic projects or coordinating initiatives across multiple stakeholders.
* Exceptional organizational skills, with the ability to anticipate needs, manage competing priorities, and work independently.
* Excellent written and verbal communication skills, including experience developing presentations and executive-level materials.
* Strong judgment, attention to detail, and the ability to handle highly confidential and sensitive information.
* Advanced proficiency in Microsoft Office, particularly Outlook, PowerPoint, and Excel.
* Comfortable leveraging AI tools and emerging technologies to streamline workflows and improve productivity.
* Responsive, flexible, and comfortable working onsite five days per week, with the ability to adjust schedule as business needs require.

**Compensation**

The anticipated base salary range for this position is listed below. In addition to a competitive base salary, you will be eligible to receive discretionary bonus incentives and a comprehensive benefits package.

Anticipated base salary range: $110,000-140,000  
Actual base salary within the anticipated range will be determined by several components including but not limited to the individual's experience, skills, qualifications, and market factors.

Overview:

Formed in 1972, Related is one of the most prominent privately-owned real estate firms in the United States. Headquartered in New York City, the company has offices and major developments across the world. Related owns and manages a premier portfolio of assets valued at over $100 billion, including the 28-acre Hudson Yards neighborhood on Manhattan’s West Side.

Related believes in investing in its talent and cultivates a positive, team-oriented environment where every voice is valued. Employees are encouraged to boldly take on new challenges, transcend the status quo, and demonstrate strong entrepreneurial spirit. In its relentless commitment to excellence, Related works to foster an innovative approach in its team members so that they can positively impact the communities in which they conduct business. Learn more about Related at www.related.com.

**Project Coordinator**

Grid Strategy & Solutions | Power Delivery | Georgia Power Company

Location: GPC HQ - Atlanta, GA, USA

**JOB SUMMARY**

At Georgia Power, we are committed to making smart investments for Georgia's energy future to ensure our customers are provided clean, safe, reliable, and affordable energy. To meet growing electricity demand, we are deploying emerging technologies and strategically investing in our grid to keep service reliable and affordable for our customers.

The Grid Strategy & Solutions (GSS) team leads Georgia Power's pursuit and execution of federal and state funding, along with emerging grid technology initiatives. The programs that GSS manages for Power Delivery represent a growing, multi-billion-dollar portfolio that must be executed with discipline, accuracy, and strong cross-functional coordination.

The Project Coordinator will play a pivotal role supporting Georgia Power's Strategic Projects within Grid Strategy & Solutions. Reporting to the Project Manager for federal funding, this position supports the project managers and technical leads on the team while owning responsibility for the coordination of logistics, compliance, and reporting deliverables, and facilitating communication across internal teams and external agencies. The Coordinator helps keep the portfolio moving from funding award through execution by maintaining trackers and schedules, compiling reports and compliance deliverables, organizing project documentation, and preparing clear materials for leadership and external partners. In addition, this position supports the identification and evaluation of strategic funding opportunities and the integration of emerging grid technologies that help modernize grid infrastructure and improve system reliability.

The Community Activities & Services Coordinator designs and implements programs that enhance community life for residents of all ages. They serve as a vital link between residents and services, creating value through targeted initiatives that address community needs. This role requires an innovative, proactive individual who excels in an autonomous environment, driving positive long-term outcomes through an understanding of the communities in which they serve.

* Implement core programs and services, which include connecting, engaging, and empowering residents across four initiatives: Economic Stability, Education for Youth & Families, Health & Wellness, and Community Building.

**What you'll bring**

* Experience in community outreach, resident services, social services, education, youth programming, multifamily housing, or a related field preferred; equivalent lived, volunteer, or community-based experience may also be considered.

Ballpark Music (BPM) specializes in producing large-scale postgame concerts in stadiums across the country. jobs.title: Customer Success Representative
jobs.description:
**Who We Are**  
Porter Logistics started in 2017 with two founders, one 3,000-square-foot warehouse and no customers. We won our first accounts one at a time by taking on the work other warehouses turned down and doing the work better than our clients expected.  
  
Today Porter runs four facilities across Atlanta and the Savannah port area. We handle the hard stuff: hazardous and specialty chemicals, food-grade and temperature-controlled freight from ambient to frozen, bonded imports and bulk chemical repackaging. Our customers include Fortune 500 manufacturers and global distributors in chemicals, food and beverage, consumer goods and building materials. They have their pick of 3PLs. They choose us.  
  
We've grown every year since we opened, and 2026 is on pace for 40% growth. Growth means new sites, new roles and room to move up. Many of our leaders started in entry-level roles here.  
  
**The Role**  
As a Customer Sucecss Representative, you'll be the first call for our clients and the source of clean, accurate orders for our warehouse team. Each day you'll enter client orders into our WMS, build pick lists and shipping documents, update the warehouse team on changes and priorities, close completed orders and bill each shipment. When an order, inventory count or shipment goes wrong, you'll track down the cause and work with the warehouse to fix the problem.  
  
This is a full-time hourly position based on-site at our Atlanta warehouse.  
  
**What You'll Earn**

* 20-22/hour based on experience
* Medical, dental and vision plans
* 401(k)
* Paid time off and company holidays
* Occasional overtime opportunities

**Schedule**

* Monday through Friday, 7:00 AM to 5:00 PM

  
**You'll Thrive Here If You**

* Catch a wrong SKU or quantity before an order reaches the floor
* Like owning a short list of clients and knowing every detail of their accounts
* Stay calm and clear when a client calls about a late shipment
* Want to grow with a company adding new sites and new clients

  
**This Might Not Be For You If**

* You prefer one task at a time. You'll manage orders for 3 to 5 clients at once.
* You'd rather pass a problem along than own the fix
* You want a role with no accountability for billing errors

  
**What You'll Be Responsible For**

* Serve as the main point of contact for 3 to 5 client accounts.
* Enter daily client orders into the WMS accurately.
* Share order details, changes and priorities with the warehouse team.
* Generate pick lists, order packets and outbound shipping documents.
* Investigate and resolve order, inventory and fulfillment issues.
* Close out completed orders in the WMS.
* Bill shipments to the correct client accounts.

  
**What We're Looking For**

* 1+ year in customer service, operations support or a similar role requiring strong attention to detail, organization and customer service skills
* Clear, professional phone and email communication
* Strong organization across several accounts at once
* Proficiency in Microsoft Excel, Outlook and Word
* WMS experience preferred, not required
* Logistics, warehousing or supply chain experience preferred, not required

  
**The Hiring Process**  
We respect your time. If your background fits, a member of our HR team will call you for a short phone screen. Next, you'll visit the warehouse for an in-person interview, meet the team and tour the facility.

***We are looking for a Counter Sales Associate to join our growing team!***

At PDI, our goal is to always be committed to providing quality products with prompt, efficient, courteous service in all segments of our business. We pride ourselves in keeping flexibility of procedures and policy at the forefront so that customer needs are always satisfied.

Since 1973, we have maintained our position as a leader in the wholesale distribution industry and offer first-class service to customers in the residential and commercial plumbing industries, as well as home builders, interior designers, re-modelers, and homeowners. We operate 19 branch locations and 13 showrooms throughout Georgia, Tennessee, and South Carolina.

**Function**: As a Counter Sales Associate, your primary responsibility is to assist customers with their product inquiries, process orders, and provide exceptional service at the sales counter. You will serve as the main point of contact for walk-in customers, contractors, and plumbers, ensuring their needs are met and contributing to the overall sales and profitability of the branch.

**Principal Duties and Responsibilities:**

* Greet customers as they arrive at the counter, assess their needs, and provide product recommendations and solutions based on their requirements. Answer inquiries about product availability, specifications, pricing, and application, providing accurate and detailed information to assist customers in making purchasing decisions.
* Process sales orders, quotes, and invoices accurately and efficiently using the company's order entry system. Verify product availability, pricing, and discounts, and confirm order details with customers to ensure accuracy and satisfaction.
* Develop a comprehensive understanding of the company's product offerings, including plumbing fixtures, fittings, pipes, valves, and accessories. Stay informed about new products, promotions, and industry trends to effectively educate customers and promote sales opportunities.
* Identify opportunities to cross-sell or upsell related products and accessories to customers based on their needs and preferences. Recommend complementary items, upgrades, or alternative solutions to maximize sales and enhance customer satisfaction.
* Provide friendly, professional, and responsive service to all customers, addressing their inquiries, concerns, and requests in a timely and courteous manner. Resolve customer complaints or issues promptly and escalate complex issues to the appropriate supervisor or manager for resolution.
* Assist with order fulfillment processes, including picking, packing, and staging orders for customer pickup or delivery. Coordinate with warehouse and logistics teams to ensure timely and accurate order fulfillment and minimize order processing errors or delays.
* Process cash, credit card, and check transactions accurately and securely, following established cash handling procedures and protocols. Balance cash register at the end of each shift and reconcile any discrepancies with supervisor or manager oversight.
* Maintain a clean, organized, and safe work environment at the counter area, adhering to company policies, safety regulations, and industry standards. Follow proper procedures for handling hazardous materials, maintaining equipment, and ensuring workplace safety for employees and customers.
* Collaborate effectively with colleagues in sales, customer service, warehouse, and management to meet customer needs, resolve issues, and achieve sales targets. Communicate product availability, customer feedback, and sales opportunities to relevant team members to support overall branch success.

**Principle Qualifications**

* High school diploma or equivalent; associate or bachelor’s degree preferred.
* Previous experience in sales, customer service, or counter sales, preferably in the plumbing wholesale industry.
* Strong interpersonal and communication skills, with the ability to build rapport and establish positive relationships with customers.
* Excellent product knowledge and understanding of plumbing materials, fixtures, and equipment.
* Proficiency in computer skills, including POS systems, order entry software, and Microsoft Office applications.
* Ability to multitask, prioritize tasks, and work efficiently in a fast-paced environment.
* Detail-oriented with a focus on accuracy and quality in all aspects of work.
* Customer-focused mindset with a commitment to delivering exceptional service and exceeding customer expectations.

**Catering Sales Representative – Join GYRO GYRO DUNWOODY!**
------------------------------------------------------------

At GYRO GYRO DUNWOODY, located in the heart of Dunwoody, GA, we’re passionate about serving up delicious Mediterranean flavors and creating memorable dining experiences. Now, we’re looking for a part-time **Catering Sales Representative** to help us grow our catering business by building strong relationships with local organizations and turning first-time customers into loyal regulars. If you’re a go-getter with a knack for sales and a love for food, we’d love to hear from you!

### **Responsibilities**

As our Catering Sales Representative, you’ll focus on connecting with local offices, schools, churches, teams, and other organizations to grow our catering business. Here’s what your day-to-day will look like:

* Build and manage a list of potential customers by making calls, sending emails, visiting locations, and hosting tastings.
* Quote orders from our price list, close deals, and ensure all order details—like headcount, allergies, timing, and setup—are accurate before handing them off to the kitchen.
* Personally follow up with every new client after their first order and be on-site for big first-time setups.
* Maintain relationships with existing accounts by checking in monthly and encouraging repeat orders.
* Regularly review your sales pipeline and progress with the owner.

This role is all about finding new customers, winning their trust, and keeping them coming back, so you’ll spend your time building relationships—not packing pans or handling deliveries.

### **Qualifications**

We’re looking for someone with:

* **1+ year of experience** in B2B sales, catering or event sales, or account management with named clients.
* A proven track record of finding new customers and generating your own leads.
* A valid driver’s license and an insured vehicle.
* Availability to work **15–20 hours per week** on weekdays.

Bonus points if you have:

* Existing contacts at offices, schools, or organizations in Dunwoody, Perimeter, Sandy Springs, or Doraville.
* Experience in the restaurant or catering industry.
* Familiarity with CRM tools or ezCater.

### **Pay**

We offer a competitive pay structure:

* **$20/hour** base pay.
* **15% commission** on every new account’s first order.
* **5% commission** on reorders for the first 12 months, with additional performance-based tiers for accounts beyond 12 months.
* Quarterly bonuses for hitting growth and retention goals.

This is a part-time role with no cap on commission, so your success depends on the relationships you build and the accounts you grow.

### **How to Apply**

Ready to join our team? Apply through this posting and, in **two or three sentences**, tell us about one customer you won and how you did it. We’re excited to hear your story!

At Gyro Gyro, we’re proud to be an equal opportunity employer. We welcome applicants from all backgrounds, including veterans and military spouses. Let’s grow something delicious together!

jobs.title: Business Development Representative (BDR)
jobs.description:
**About Climb**
===============

Climb is an AI-native Data & AI consultancy and Databricks partner. We help healthcare, life sciences, financial services and insurance companies get data and AI projects out of pilot and into production. Instead of large consulting teams, we staff small, senior engineering pods on fixed-scope engagements that reach production in 8 to 12 weeks.

We build long-term partnerships with the data teams we work with, and we grow our people the same way: through direct mentorship from founders and senior architects and real exposure to enterprise deals from day one.

**Role Summary**
================

We're looking for a Business Development Representative to open new accounts for Climb across regulated industries. You'll research companies running on Databricks or evaluating it, find the business problems their data teams are stuck on, and start conversations with the people who own them. You'll pair directly with a senior member of Climb’s GTM team and work alongside our solution architects and Databricks account teams on every pursuit, and you'll see how enterprise consulting deals are scoped and won.

We don't have a big-brand inbound engine. Every meeting we book comes from someone who found the right account, figured out who owned the problem, and started a real conversation.

**Key Responsibilities**
========================

* Drive new-logo acquisition across healthcare, life sciences, financial services and insurance accounts.
* Build and manage pipeline through outbound prospecting across phone, email and LinkedIn, plus referrals and industry events.
* Plan and run account-based campaigns into named target accounts, coordinated with marketing and your Databricks counterparts.
* Build relationships across data, IT, compliance and executive leadership, and understand who decides what.
* Identify business challenges and translate them into data, analytics and AI opportunities our architects can scope.
* Run discovery on early-stage opportunities and co-run deals alongside your sales partner.
* Co-sell with Databricks account teams on shared accounts in your territory, and run a recurring sync with your assigned Databricks account executives and partner managers.
* Collaborate with solution architects and delivery leads to shape winning pursuits.
* Travel to represent Climb at client meetings, Databricks events, industry forums and Climb-hosted workshops.
* Track your activity and results, and help shape the playbook as we grow.

**What Success Looks Like**
===========================

* **30 days:** You know our offerings and target accounts, and you've met your Databricks counterparts and set a recurring sync with each.
* **60 days:** You're booking qualified meetings you sourced yourself every week.
* **90 days:** You're consistently hitting your pipeline target and have contributed to at least one active opportunity.
* **6 months:** You're at full pipeline target, running discovery on your own, and co-running opportunities with your GTM partner.

**Required Qualifications**
===========================

* 2+ years in a BDR or SDR seat, with a track record of meetings you sourced yourself, not just inbound follow-up.
* Experience selling to technical, IT or data buyers. Backgrounds in data infrastructure, cloud, developer tools or technical recruiting are a strong fit.
* Comfort with cold calling and hunting for contacts, and the ability to explain why you went after an account and why you started with the person you did.
* Ability to research accounts and understand buyer personas and decision-making structures.
* Curiosity about how data platforms and AI work, and the drive to learn the technology well enough to discuss it with an engineer.
* Strong client-facing presence and clear, concise writing.
* Bonus: Experience in or selling into healthcare, life sciences, financial services or insurance.

**Who Thrives Here**
====================

This role is designed for BDRs who build their own pipeline today and are growing toward owning accounts and closing deals.

* You'd rather build your own target list than wait for inbound leads.
* You know why you're calling an account, and who owns the problem, before you pick up the phone.
* You're curious about how data and AI work, and you're not shy about asking an engineer to explain it.
* You take rejection in stride and make the next call just as sharp.

**Why Climb**
=============

* **Learn from the builders.** Work directly with founders and senior architects from your first week.
* **Room to grow.** A clear path to Account Executive, with a promotion review at 12 months tied to sourced pipeline and conversion.
* **Where enterprise AI happens.** A front-row view of the Databricks ecosystem and enterprise AI work.
* **Ground floor opportunity.** Join early alongside seasoned founders to help construct our growth playbook from day one.
* **Focus on outcomes.** We measure success by tangible business value and account expansion rather than arbitrary utilization metrics.
* **Senior engineering pods.** Work directly with elite technical teams and AI tooling, free from management bloat.
* **Compounding IP.** Every enterprise win builds reusable assets and technical blueprints back into our firm.

**What We Offer**
=================

* Competitive base plus uncapped variable
* MacBook Pro and swag kit so you can do your best work
* Comprehensive health, dental, and vision insurance
* Generous holidays and flexible PTO
* 401(k) with company match
* Professional development budget including Databricks and cloud certifications
* Spot bonuses for relevant certifications
* Conference attendance and thought leadership opportunities
* Collaborative, low-ego culture with direct access to leadership
* Opportunity to shape a growing practice from the ground floor

Climb is an equal opportunity employer. We celebrate diversity and are committed to creating an inclusive environment for all employees. All qualified applicant

Maid to Glow is an established residential and commercial cleaning company serving Metro Atlanta since 2017. We provide professional cleaning services to offices, medical facilities, commercial buildings, churches, schools, and other businesses throughout the region.

We're expanding our commercial cleaning division and looking for a motivated, outgoing, and results-driven **Commercial Cleaning Sales Representative** to help us acquire and close new commercial clients and grow our business.

**Overview**

This is a full-time, proactive sales position combining outside sales, cold calling, email outreach, and in-person business development.

You'll be responsible for building and managing your own pipeline of commercial cleaning opportunities, from identifying potential customers and connecting with decision-makers to conducting walkthroughs, following up, and helping close new contracts.

**This is not a position where you'll wait for leads to come in.** We're looking for someone who takes initiative, actively seeks out new business, and is comfortable approaching potential customers through multiple channels.

You'll be training and working directly with the CEO!

You'll work remotely when conducting research, making calls, and sending emails, and spend time in the field visiting businesses and meeting prospective clients throughout Metro Atlanta.

\*Earn up to 20% of the 1st month's collected revenue on each new commercial cleaning contract secured - percentage based on contract size! No ceiling.

Key Responsibilities

* **Outbound Sales & Prospecting:** Actively identify and contact potential commercial cleaning clients through cold calling, personalized emails, LinkedIn, and other outreach methods
* **In-Person Business Development:** Visit local offices, commercial properties, medical facilities, and other businesses to introduce Maid to Glow's services and connect with decision-makers
* **Lead Generation:** Research potential customers, identify property managers, facility managers, office managers, and business owners responsible for cleaning services
* **Walkthroughs & Meetings:** Participate in on-site walkthroughs to understand prospective clients' cleaning needs and identify opportunities (walkthroughs scheduled through other 3rd party services)
* **Sales Pipeline Management:** Maintain an organized pipeline of prospects, follow-ups, walkthroughs, proposals, and potential contracts
* **Follow-Up & Relationship Building:** Consistently follow up with prospective clients through calls, emails, and in-person meetings to move opportunities toward closing
* **Sales Collaboration:** Work closely with company leadership to develop competitive proposals, pricing, and solutions for prospective customers
* **Business Development Strategy:** Identify promising industries, business districts, and commercial properties to target for new business
* **Performance & Accountability:** Meet weekly outreach, prospecting, walkthrough, and sales goals while accurately tracking activities in our CRM

**When you're not meeting with prospective customers or conducting walkthroughs, your primary responsibility will be actively generating new business through outbound prospecting.**

Qualifications

* Previous experience in outside sales, business development, or B2B sales preferred
* Strong cold calling, prospecting, and relationship-building skills
* Comfortable approaching businesses in person and speaking with decision-makers
* Excellent written and verbal communication skills (must be social)
* Self-motivated, organized, and comfortable working independently
* Ability to manage multiple prospects and maintain consistent follow-up
* Experience using CRM software and basic sales tools

Experience in commercial cleaning, janitorial services, facility maintenance, or related B2B services is a plus, but not required.

At Maid to Glow, you'll be joining an established company with a strong reputation, an experienced operations team, and the infrastructure to support continued growth.

**Experience in restoration is welcome, but it is not required.** We’re interested in your ability to connect with people, take initiative, and follow through.

**Your Experience Could Be a Great Fit**

Have you worked in HVAC, insulation, garage doors, roofing, windows and doors, plumbing, remodeling, property management, or repairs?

You don’t need “sales representative” on your résumé. You do need to be comfortable recommending a solution and asking for the business.

**About Barex and the Industry**

Barex helps customers recover from water damage, mold, and other property damage, including the repairs that follow. Restoration brings together many aspects of home services in situations where customers need a quick response, clear guidance, and dependable work.

You’ll learn a specialized industry where relationship building, customer service, sales, and project execution all work together.

**What You Will Do**

**Meet homeowners and close work**

Attend customer appointments and respond to emergency service opportunities.

Follow up on open opportunities and keep your sales pipeline organized.  
Set clear expectations and coordinate with our team to get authorized work started.  

**Take ownership beyond the sale**

Learn mitigation procedures, equipment use, job documentation, and project coordination.  

Participate in hands-on fieldwork, equipment setup, and progress checks as needed.  
Stay involved with the projects you sell and keep homeowners informed.  
Work with technicians and office staff to support timely completion.  
Assist with insurance-related documentation and communication alongside our office team.  

**Your First 60 Days**

You’ll work alongside our team to learn our services, customer consultation process, and field operations. At the same time, you’ll begin developing referral relationships and building your book of business.

As you demonstrate readiness, we’ll progressively assign homeowner appointments and give you greater responsibility for closing and coordinating projects. The goal is to help you become confident representing Barex from the first introduction through job completion.

**A Path Toward Management**

We’re looking for someone who can become a trusted right hand to our local office.

Strong sales performance is part of that. So are sound judgment, organization, customer care, and the ability to help others succeed. As you develop, opportunities may include:

Leading referral account development.  

Training and supporting new team members.  
Coordinating crews, schedules, and project resources.  
Helping improve sales follow-up and job completion.  
Taking on broader office and operations responsibilities.  

Advancement is based on performance, leadership readiness, and available opportunities as Barex grows.

**What We’re Looking For**

Strong communication skills and a professional presence in customers’ homes.  

Confidence starting conversations with homeowners and business owners.  
Consistent follow-up and a desire to close work.  
Accountability for your commitments and results.

A valid driver’s license and the ability to travel locally.  
Availability to participate in scheduled after-hours emergency response.

Opportunities for greater responsibility as your skills and the company grow.

Job Duties and Responsibilities

**General Job Description**

The MCMF Mentor Coach is primarily responsible for providing mentorship, guidance, coaching, and direct support to youth ages 16–24 employed through the My CHI My Future Program in partnership with the Chicago Department of Family and Support Services (DFSS).

The Mentor Coach will provide direct services to a caseload of 15 youth over a pre-scheduled 40-week program period, with a required commitment of 800 hours annually, in accordance with the funder-approved program schedule. This position is responsible for supporting youth employment, professional development, participant engagement, payroll administration, program compliance, and the planning and implementation of youth-led community events.

Major Duties and Responsibilities

**Youth Recruitment, Employment & Retention**

* Recruit, screen, and facilitate the hiring of 15 youth from the Brighton Park community.

* Develop and maintain positive relationships with youth, community partners, and partner site leads.
* Communicate program expectations, policies, procedures, and employment requirements to all participants.
* Follow up with youth who demonstrate inconsistent attendance or disengagement to address barriers and encourage continued participation.

**Department**

BSD CCC - Network Oncology Research Support

**About the Department**

The University of Chicago Comprehensive Cancer Center (UCCCC) is an integral component of the Biological Sciences Division (BSD). The BSD is the largest of four Divisions of the University and includes the Pritzker School of Medicine. UCCCC administers four established scientific programs, and the NCI-sponsored Cancer Center Support Grant funds ten Shared Resources. The Comprehensive Cancer Center comprises over 190 faculty members from twenty departments, with members currently being awarded over $47 million in total direct costs in peer-reviewed cancer research grants, and $28 million in non-peer-reviewed grants and contracts. The activities of the Center are broad and varied, including research, training and education, communications, fundraising, marketing, clinical trials management, and community outreach.  
  
UCCCC has one of the largest cancer clinical trials programs in the country and in the Chicago area, with nearly 500 adult and pediatric therapeutic trials actively accruing patients. Many of these studies are investigator-initiated, including Phase I or I/II trials, demonstrating UCCCC's commitment to translating basic research findings to the clinic through proof-of-principle and early-phase studies. UCCCC opens over 250 new trials each year and accrues approximately 900 participants to therapeutic trials each year.

**Job Summary**

The Clinical Research Coordinator 2 (CRC2) is a specialized researcher partnering with the clinical Principal Investigator (PI) and under the direction of a departmental or lab research manager. While the Principal Investigator is primarily responsible for the overall design, conduct, and management of the clinical trial, the CRC2 supports, facilitates and coordinates independently the daily clinical trial activities and plays a critical role in the conduct of the study. By performing these duties with limited supervision and/or guidance, the CRC2 works with the PI, department, sponsor, and institution to support and provide guidance on the administration of the compliance, financial, personnel and other related aspects of the clinical study.

**Responsibilities**

* Manages all aspects of conducting clinical trials including screening, enrollment, subject follow-up, completion of the case report form, and adverse event reports.
* Recruits and interviews potential study patients with guidance from PI and other clinical research staff.
* Collects, processes, ships and stores specimens to appropriate laboratory according to established aseptic techniques.
* Identifies and explains the responsibilities of principal investigators, research team members, sponsors, contract research organizations (CROs), and regulatory authorities related to the conduct of a clinical trial.
* Coordinates the conduct of the study from startup through closeout including recruitment and screening of study subjects, obtaining informed consent, collecting research data, and ensuring protocol adherence.
* Plans and coordinates patient schedule for study procedures, return visits, and study treatment schedules.
* Educates patients about study procedures to be performed, visit schedule, what to report between and during visits, and the risks and benefits of the procedures.
* Performs assessments at visits and monitors for adverse events.
* Organizes and attends site visits from sponsors and other relevant study meetings.
* Protects patients and data confidentiality by ensuring security of research data and personal health information and compliance with federal regulations and sponsor protocols.
* Ensures Standard Operating Procedures (SOP) are implemented and documented in accordance to study sponsor, primary investigator, and regulatory agency specifications.
* Maintains accurate and complete records which may include, but are not limited to, signed informed consent, relevant IRB approvals, source documentation, Case Report Forms (CRF's), drug dispensing logs, and study related communication.
* Understands the IRB submission and review process and when and how to apply for IRB review, including facilitation of study initiation through meticulous and timely preparation of IRB submissions independently.
* Ensures compliance with federal regulations and institutional policies.
* May prepare and maintain protocol submissions and revisions.
* May assist in the training of new or backup coordinators.
* Assists with various professional, organizational, and operational tasks under moderate supervision.
* Facilitates and participates in the daily activities of moderately complex clinical studies and performs various activities including patient data retrieval, documenting clinical research records, and participation in program audits.
* Uses knowledge of clinical studies to coordinate the collection of analyzable clinical research data and/or sampleswith a limited to moderate degree of independence. Contributes to the problem solving on assigned clinical research studies and tasks.
* Performs other related work as needed.

Minimum requirements include a college or university degree in related field.

**Work Experience:**

If you are a current DSV employee and interested in a position in another country,please contact your Human Resource representative to discuss the process and requirements of applying.

Job area: Commercial

**DSV - Global transport and logistics**

  

In 1976, ten independent hauliers joined forces and founded DSV in Denmark. Since then, DSV has evolved to become the world's 3rd largest supplier of global solutions within transport and logistics. Today, we add value to our customers' entire supply chain by transporting, storing, packaging, re-packaging, processing and clearing all types of goods. We work every day from our many offices in more than 80 countries to ensure a steady supply of goods to production lines, outlets, stores and consumers all over the world. Our reach is global yet our presence is local and close to our customers. Read more at www.dsv.com

Location: USA - Itasca, N Arlington Heights Rd

Division: Road
  
Job Posting Title: Operational Account Manager, Road US
  
Time Type: Full Time

  

**Summary**

DSV is looking for an Operational Account Manager to own the day-to-day execution, customer relationships, and overall account performance within our domestic freight brokerage operation. This role combines hands-on transportation operations with customer account management, giving you direct ownership of shipments from initial request and pricing through pickup, transit, and final delivery.

  

You'll work closely with customers, Carrier Sales, carriers, and internal teams to develop transportation solutions that balance service, capacity, pricing, and customer-specific requirements. Along the way, you'll maintain shipment visibility, communicate proactively with customers, resolve exceptions, provide pricing direction, and ensure freight moves efficiently and according to plan.

  

Beyond managing individual shipments, you'll develop and manage your assigned accounts by analyzing transportation spend, service performance, and shipment trends, leading customer business reviews, and identifying opportunities to improve performance and expand existing relationships. Whether that means adding lanes, increasing shipment volume, introducing additional services, or developing solutions to a customer challenge, you'll play an active role in growing the business you support.

  

If you bring domestic freight brokerage or transportation experience, strong customer relationship management skills, and the ability to stay ahead of changing operational demands, this is an opportunity to take real ownership of your accounts while building your career with the world's largest freight forwarding and logistics company.

  

**Duties & Responsibilities**

* Serve as the primary point of contact for assigned customers, developing strong, long-term relationships through proactive communication, consistent service, and effective account management.
* Manage day-to-day freight brokerage operations for assigned accounts, overseeing shipment execution from initial customer request and pricing through pickup, transit, and final delivery.
* Evaluate customer transportation requests and develop appropriate solutions based on service requirements, carrier capacity, pricing, transit times, and other customer-specific needs.
* Partner closely with Carrier Sales to identify qualified carrier capacity and transportation solutions that meet customer, operational, and shipment requirements.
* Provide pricing guidance and direction to Carrier Sales based on customer requirements, market conditions, available capacity, service expectations, and account strategy.
* Negotiate transportation rates and service requirements with carriers and transportation providers, as appropriate.
* Ensure customer-specific handling, communication, tracking, and service requirements are understood and communicated to appropriate internal teams and transportation providers.
* Monitor active shipments, maintain visibility throughout the shipment lifecycle, and proactively communicate shipment status, milestones, delays, and exceptions to customers and internal stakeholders.
* Identify, troubleshoot, and resolve shipment exceptions, service failures, delays, and other operational concerns, coordinating timely resolution and escalating significant issues in accordance with established procedures.
* Maintain accurate and timely shipment, customer, carrier, pricing, and operational information within the Transportation Management System (TMS) and other required systems.
* Analyze customer transportation spend, shipment activity, service performance, pricing, and account trends to identify risks, opportunities for improvement, and areas for increased profitability.
* Prepare and present customer reporting, including transportation spend, service performance, operational metrics, and other account-related information.
* Conduct regular customer meetings, including Monthly Business Reviews (MBRs) and Quarterly Business Reviews (QBRs), to evaluate account performance, address concerns, and identify improvement opportunities.
* Identify and develop opportunities to expand existing customer relationships through additional lanes, increased shipment volume, expanded services, and other transportation solutions.
* Research and develop growth opportunities within assigned branch house accounts and support new customer opportunities as assigned.
* Partner with customers and internal stakeholders to develop solutions that improve service, operational efficiency, profitability, and overall account performance.
* Maintain knowledge of transportation market conditions, carrier capacity, pricing trends, customer requirements, and available service solutions to support operational and account management decisions.
* Build and maintain effective working relationships across departments, business units, customers, carriers, vendors, and other external business partners.
* Maintain confidentiality and appropriately handle sensitive customer,

jobs.description:
**Job Summary**

As an Account Manager, you’ll build strong business-to-business (B2B) client relationships and guide customers toward technology solutions that meet their needs. You’ll combine consultative selling, clear communication, and consistent follow-through to develop opportunities and close deals. Your impact: By matching clients with relevant solutions and responsive service, you help them address business needs and build lasting partnerships.

**Duties**

* Manage client relationships through proactive client communication and customer service.
* Identify and qualify opportunities through outbound calling, warm calling, inside sales, and telemarketing.
* Lead consultative sales conversations, present technology solutions, negotiate terms, and close deals.
* Maintain accurate account activity, pipeline records, and follow-up tasks in Salesforce Cloud and other customer relationship management (CRM) software.
* Use sales automation technologies and support sales technology adoption to organize outreach and improve workflow.

**Qualifications**

* Strong English communication skills, including confident phone communication and clear client updates.
* Experience in sales, B2B sales, technology sales, or technical sales; inside sales or call center experience is relevant.
* Proficiency with Salesforce, Salesforce Cloud, or another CRM system; familiarity with sales automation technologies is an asset.
* Demonstrated consultative selling, negotiation, and deal-closing skills.
* Ability to manage client relationships, provide customer service, and use sales technology effectively.

Pay: $45.00 - $50.00 per hour

Expected hours: 20.0 per week

Benefits:

* 401(k)
* 401(k) matching
* Work from home

Work Location: Hybrid remote in Naperville, IL 60540

jobs.description:
Interested in working in aviation? Are you looking for a job with stability and growth opportunities? If you are looking for a career with growth potential and work well in a fast-paced, **team-oriented environment, we want to speak to you!**

  

**WHY WORK FOR PRIMEFLIGHT?**

* Enjoy benefits like 401(k) with matching, health, dental, vision, and life insurance, paid time off, growth opportunities, and more *(\*Benefits may vary based on eligibility)*
* We are committed to being a leading provider of commercial services within the aviation industry
* Our teams focus on maintaining a positive working environment and treating all team members with respect
* With more than 200 locations across the world, we offer opportunities for career progression

  

**SUMMARY OVERVIEW**

The Account Manager will be tasked with maintaining customer records, ensuring client satisfaction, and promoting new business. You are responsible for account payment management, issue resolution, and assistance in service or product selection. The role also involves building and managing new partnerships and adhering to Key Performance Indicators and Standard Operating Procedures. Key skills include excellent communication, problem-solving abilities, and experience in travel-related fields.

  

**RESPONSIBILITIES**

* Develop and maintain strong relationships with clients, understanding their unique requirements and ensuring their satisfaction
* Collaborate with clients to identify opportunities for service enhancements and provide solutions to meet their goals
* Coordinate with internal departments to ensure the timely and effective delivery of services to clients
* Monitor client accounts, track performance metrics, and analyze data to identify trends and areas for improvement
* Prepare and present regular reports to clients, summarizing service performance, achievements, and recommendations
* Resolve client inquiries, concerns, and issues promptly and professionally
* Collaborate with the sales team to identify upsell and cross-sell opportunities within existing client accounts
* Ensuring each position is covered and all requirements of the contract are met

* Assisting with tip reporting (if applicable), call out logs, records, passenger logs, electronic passenger assist by staff on shift or any required forms
* Ensuring all incoming staff members have on-the-job training
* Communicating with airlines and other customers to provide exceptional customer service
* Ensure staff is meeting safety standards
* Counseling, Coaching and Participating in Disciplinary Actions
* Demonstrate regular, predictable attendance at job location
* Collaborate with the sales team to identify upsell and cross-sell opportunities within existing client accounts
* Perform any additional duties as assigned by management

  

**QUALIFICATIONS**

* 18 years of age or older
* Must be legally authorized to work in the country of employment.
* Must hold a valid driver's license.
* Communicate effectively in English (reading, writing, speaking)
* Bilingual in English/Spanish a plus
* Previous aviation experience in either ramp operations or customer service is required
* 2 Years of Customer Management
* Knowledge of the Aviation Industry
* Intermediate/Highly proficient Word, Excel, PowerPoint, Outlook
* Ability to access and interpret information in print and electronically, including the use of electronic devices including IPads/Tablets, Computers, and Mobile Devices
* Effectively communicate with colleagues and clients, both in-person and through electronic means
* Pass a background check and drug screen
* Eligibility to acquire needed credentials and clearances (FAA, RAIC, TSA, Port Authority, U.S. Customs and U.S. Postal- as applicable).
* Airlines are 24/7, so we need our team members to be flexible to work various shifts including nights, weekends and holidays
* Must be flexible to work extended hours on occasion to support our field operations

  

To perform this job successfully, an individual must be able to perform each essential requirement satisfactorily. The requirements listed above are representative of the work environment, knowledge, skill, and/or ability. Reasonable accommodation may be made to enable individuals with disabilities to perform the essential requirements.

  

**PHYSICAL ACTIVITY/WORKING CONDITIONS MAY INCLUDE:**

* Ability to lift up to 25 pounds
* Position is generally sedentary, sitting for long periods of time
* Be able to hear and respond to the spoken voice and to audible alarms
* Tasks may involve repetitive motions of the arms, wrists, hands and/or fingers
* Specific vision abilities required for this job include: Close vision (clear vision at 20 inches or less); distance vision (clear vision at 20 feet or more); peripheral vision (ability to observe an area that can be seen up and down or to the left and right while eyes are fixed on a given point); depth perception (three-dimensional vision, ability to judge distances and spatial relationships); ability to adjust focus (ability to adjust the eye to bring an object into sharp focus)

jobs.description:
Track Group Inc., a global leader in the provision of advanced electronic monitoring and supervision solutions to the criminal justice/corrections market. For over 27 years, we have been providing our global clients with the industry’s most reliable location tracking devices, complemented by flexible software, analytics, and app-driven monitoring solutions along with multi-levels of support services. We have a proven record of success leveraging new tracking technologies to create valuable solutions for our customers and maximize investment returns for our shareholders.

**General Job Description: Regional Account Manager-Central**

A key member of the Customer Service & Account Management Team, the Regional Account Manager, will report to the Director of Account Management. Maintains close continuous support of assigned accounts to ensure high customer satisfaction and retention through systematic customer contact, training activities, and implementation of new programs requirements. Actively works with assigned accounts to identify growth opportunities through the increased use of Track Group’s continuum of products and Services. Provides programmatic assistance to allow each customer to operate an effective program with high satisfactions levels.

* Develops and delivers presentations and ongoing training on usages of Track Group’s equipment and software products to ensure customers’ effective and successful use of the programs.
* Identifies and evaluates ongoing customer training needs and conducts follow-up training as required.
* Completes, updates, and maintains customer contact information
* Monitors customer database and ensures contact every 90 days.
* Implement strategies to grow and retain assigned accounts and develop accounts profiles and accounts plans for each assigned account.
* Meets revenue, profit, and timeline targets for growth in identified accounts.
* Coordinates all new sales opportunities with the Sales Representative
* Refer new sales and growth opportunities leads to Sales Representatives.
* Assist new customers in the implementation and the start-up of new monitoring programs.
* Assist Monitoring Center and CSS with host site Technical Support, including training and identifications of areas requiring follow-up training.
* Identifies and develops relationships with Key customer’s contacts at the officer/user level including Officers, Agents, Program Managers and Directors.
* Provides programmatic assistance to users to ensure long-term usage and satisfaction with the system. Keeps abreast of incidents that require follow-up to ensure timely completion to the customers’ satisfactions.
* Utilize internal programs for reporting incoming calls, any equipment/software related issues.
* Assists with billing related administrative issues and price corrections and /or credits. (must be approved by Management)
* Provides products performance feedback to Customer Service Director and Support.
* Maintains customer information files with documentation, including equipment utilization and customer complaints. Maintain adequate inventory levels per contractual allowance.
* Assists Customer Service Director in conducting customer satisfactions surveys. Ensure follow through on problem areas.
* Provide monthly reports to respective Customer Service Director, indication of the month’s activities, growth, inventory levels and operational issues, action taken to resolve them, customer personnel and operational changes, field visit reports, online training reports, objectives for the following month, and business expense reports.
* Responsibilities can include 24-hour support for assigned accounts, either by phone or e-mail.
* Extensive Travel can be up to (50%+) within assigned accounts. Although Saturday and Sunday travel is rare it may be required.

**Supervisory Responsibilities:**

* None.

**Competencies:**

* Knowledge and experience with criminal justice systems and government procurement process would be preferred.
* Understanding company operations.
* Ability to perform at a high level.
* Excellent communication skills.
* Strong organizational skills with a problem-solving attitude.

**Travel Requirements:**

* Availability to travel as needed.

 **Benefits**  

* *Generous amounts of time away from work* to promote a healthy work-life balance. We offer *unlimited paid vacation days* in addition to observing *12 major holidays per year.*
* Access to Medical, Dental and Vision insurances with a *company contribution* for you and any covered dependents.

jobs.title: Group Benefits Sales Representative, Premier - Chicago, IL
jobs.description:
**Position Summary****:**

Guardian is seeking a Group Benefits Sales Representative to build and deepen relationships with leading brokers, consultants, and clients while driving profitable new business and retention in the large-market segment. You will bring Guardian's full portfolio of benefits and technology-enabled solutions to market, translate complex client needs into differentiated strategies, and serve as a trusted resource throughout the sales lifecycle. Success requires disciplined territory and pipeline management, strong cross-functional partnership, and a consistent focus on the broker and client experience. This role reports to the Market Leader for the assigned territory.

**You are****:**

  

* A consultative, externally focused sales leader who earns credibility with sophisticated brokers, consulting houses, and large employers.
* A strategic relationship builder who combines market insight, executive presence, and disciplined follow-through to create durable growth.
* Comfortable navigating complex, multi-product opportunities and aligning underwriting, product, enrollment, implementation, service, and client-management partners around a clear client strategy.
* A collaborative and accountable teammate who uses data, technology, and competitive intelligence to prioritize opportunities and improve sales effectiveness.
* Committed to acting with integrity, inspiring well-being, and representing Guardian as a visible market and community leader.

**You have****:**

**Required qualifications**:

  

* Bachelor's degree or equivalent combination of education and relevant industry experience.
* At least 5 years of group insurance sales experience, or an equivalent combination of Guardian experience, education, and related professional experience.
* Demonstrated success meeting or exceeding sales and retention goals in the large-market segment.
* Experience selling ancillary employee benefits in the 1,000+ life space
* Experience developing and managing complex opportunities and relationships with large regional or national brokers, consultants, and employer clients.
* Strong knowledge of group benefits products and sales processes, including Dental, Vision, Life, Disability, Absence, Supplemental Health, and Worksite solutions.
* Advanced consultative selling, presentation, negotiation, and relationship-management skills, with the ability to influence external stakeholders and cross-functional partners.

**Lead Digital Production Coordinator (Hybrid)**

The American Medical Association (AMA) is the nation's largest professional Association of physicians and a non-profit organization. We are a unifying voice and powerful ally for America's physicians, the patients they care for, and the promise of a healthier nation. We have an opportunity at our corporate offices in Chicago for a **Lead Digital Production Coordinator (Hybrid)** on our Education Center team. This is a hybrid position reporting into our Chicago, IL office, requiring 3 days a week in the office.

  

As a Lead Digital Production Coordinator, you will coordinate and execute production operations to support the digital publication and transformation of medical education. Develop and refine XML-based publishing processes and content formats to support new media and content offerings. Monitor and complete publishing workflows, troubleshoot complex production issues, and maintain consistency across digital publishing channels. Collaborate with learning design, CME, production vendors, platform providers, marketing, and publication teams, providing technical guidance and coordinating vendor publishing and quality assurance activities.

**RESPONSIBILITIES:**

**Publishing Operations**

* Create, transform, and deliver data (metadata and full text conversion/tagging to XML); package and publish structured and related files for delivery to AMA platforms, aggregators, and applications
* Coordinate vendor publishing activities, delivering files based on production schedules, providing technical guidance, and monitoring accuracy, quality, and deadlines
* Monitor content keyword tagging in a finished good repository to identify and resolve tagging issues impacting transfers, partnering with IT to identify errors, e.g. DTD

* Assess and refine publication processes, developing approaches and documentation to support new content formats and publishing requirements

**Quality Assurance**

* Perform quality assurance testing of all editorial content following established guidelines to check for completeness and quality throughout of text, tables, graphics, PDF linking, and interactivity etc.; manually resolve XML issues when able, surfacing vendor-required corrections
* Prepare urgent and other post-publication correction requests as approved by management, or if adhering to content revision policy, accurately supply content for database population; and provide other information/data as required
* Ensure XML data integrity, accuracy of coding, completeness, and validity against NLM JATS (National Library of Medicine Journal Article Tagging Suite), DTD, and HighWire DTD
* Review and maintain bug tracking logs and reports to optimize workstream performance
* Effectively communicate and coordinate technical and/or workflow issues with Editorial and other Production staff to troubleshoot, modify, and resupply files as necessary; monitor inter-system interface/data transfer issues; raise any error notices received and verify content packaging adheres to platform technical requirements
* Apply CME accreditation of published content requirements and documentation

**Planning & Collaboration**

* Coordinate the testing of new XML functionality, platform features, and styles. Communicate technical knowledge, workflow processes, and troubleshooting guidance to stakeholders and users across departments
* Draft publishing guidelines and processes for vendors, provide technical guidance, and oversee the quality and consistency of vendor XML tagging and publication work
* Apply XML knowledge to help develop and refine content formats and publishing approaches that enhance website user engagement and user experience
* Collaborate with marketing, project management, IT, and editorial on the development of new media and content offerings, addressing technical requirements, publishing approaches, and audience experience
* Work closely with AMA content creators to develop publishing documentation and communicate content requirements, processes, and guidelines

**May include other responsibilities as assigned**

  

**REQUIREMENTS:**

* Education: Bachelor's degree preferred or equivalent work experience and HS diploma/equivalent education required (P1-P4/M1-M2)
* Years of experience: 5+ years of experience in an online publishing environment, preferably academic or journal publishing
* Bachelor’s Degree in a related field preferred (journalism, computer sciences, publishing, electronic publishing); comparable work experience in electronic or web publishing acceptable

jobs.title: Maintenance Operations Coordinator
jobs.description:
**WeDriveU** is the leader in shared mobility solutions that connect communities, campuses, and workplaces. WeDriveU operates private shuttle and public transit systems across the U.S serving millions of passenger journeys a year. The company's 5,500+ team members operate 4,000 vehicles across 55 U.S. locations, providing safe, reliable and sustainable options as part of a global family of brands serving more than 1 billion bus and rail passengers on four continents. Visit wedriveu.com to learn more about our company, clients and career opportunities.

**Position Summary**

WeDriveU is seeking a detail-oriented Maintenance Operations Coordinator to support the daily administrative and operational functions of our fleet maintenance department. This role maintains accurate maintenance records, manages work orders in Maximo, coordinates parts and inventory activities, and supports communication between Maintenance and Operations. The ideal candidate has a working understanding of automotive or fleet maintenance operations, strong organizational skills, and experience managing maintenance information and administrative processes. This is primarily an administrative position and does not involve routine hands-on vehicle repairs.

**Responsibilities**

MAINTENANCE SYSTEMS AND WORK ORDER MANAGEMENT

* Open, update, track, and close maintenance work orders in Maximo, keeping information accurate and complete.
* Enter and maintain repair information, labor details, parts usage, and related documentation.
* Monitor outstanding work orders and coordinate with maintenance personnel for timely updates and completion.
* Maintain accurate vehicle maintenance histories, service records, and supporting documentation.
* Help maintain vehicle asset information in Maximo so records reflect the current fleet at the assigned location.

MAINTENANCE ADMINISTRATION AND COORDINATION

* Support the daily administrative activities of the Maintenance Department.
* Coordinate with Operations to help schedule vehicles for preventive maintenance, inspections, and repairs.
* Facilitate communication between maintenance technicians, supervisors, vendors, and operational personnel.
* Organize and maintain maintenance records, inspection documents, invoices, and other departmental files.
* Assist maintenance leadership with administrative follow-up, documentation, and departmental priorities.

PARTS AND INVENTORY ADMINISTRATION

* Request and process quotations for maintenance parts, supplies, and outside services.
* Prepare parts and inventory requisitions for purchase order processing.
* Receive and record parts and inventory transactions in Maximo.
* Assist with tracking inventory records and reconciling discrepancies.
* Coordinate with maintenance personnel and vendors on parts orders, deliveries, and documentation.

PROCESS IMPROVEMENT, TECHNOLOGY AND AUTOMATION

* Identify opportunities to improve and automate maintenance and administrative processes to increase efficiency, effectiveness, and quality.
* Help eliminate unnecessary administrative steps, duplicate data entry, and repetitive manual tasks.
* Use company-approved AI and digital tools to streamline maintenance coordination, reporting, documentation, and follow-up activities.
* Assist with developing practical solutions that simplify workflows and improve the accuracy and timeliness of maintenance information.
* Work with maintenance leadership to identify operational challenges and recommend process improvements.
* Support the implementation of new tools, automated workflows, and improved administrative procedures.

REPORTING AND RECORD ACCURACY

* Generate maintenance reports and provide information requested by maintenance leadership.
* Monitor work order records and identify missing, incomplete, or inaccurate information.
* Support accurate tracking of maintenance activities, preventive maintenance schedules, and vehicle service histories.
* Help maintain records needed for internal reviews, audits, and applicable maintenance compliance requirements.
* Identify opportunities to improve administrative processes, documentation accuracy, and maintenance system use.

**Qualifications**

REQUIRED

* High school diploma or equivalent.
* Previous experience in automotive service, fleet maintenance administration, maintenance coordination, or a related environment.
* Working knowledge of automotive or fleet maintenance terminology, repair processes, and maintenance operations.
* Experience with computerized recordkeeping, work order systems, or maintenance management software.
* Proficiency in Microsoft Office or Google Workspace.
* Strong organizational skills, attention to detail, and the ability to manage multiple priorities.
* Strong written and verbal communication skills.
* Ability to work effectively with maintenance technicians, operations personnel, and management.

PREFERRED

* Experience using IBM Maximo or a comparable computerized maintenance management system (CMMS).
* Experience in commercial fleet maintenance, transportation, automotive dealerships, or vehicle service operations.
* Familiarity with preventive maintenance programs, parts inventory, and maintenance reporting.
* Experience supporting maintenance recordkeeping, documentation reviews, or audit preparation.
* Technical training or coursework in automotive technology, fleet maintenance, or a related discipline.

ADDITIONAL EXPECTATIONS

* Maintain accurate, confidential departmental records.
* Follow established company policies, procedures, and safety requirements.
* Maintain an organized, professional work environment.
* Demonstrate accountability for the accuracy and timeliness of assigned work.
* Perform other related duties as assigned.

**We Offer**

Physical Health

* Exceptional Medical, Dental, Vision, and Life Insurance benefits

Financial Health

* Competitive compensation packages
* 401(k) with 4% employer match
* Financial Wellness Tool
* Commuter Benefits

Emotional Health

* Medical, dental, and vision insurance
* 401(k) with company match
* Tuition reimbursement
* Mileage reimbursement

* Paid time off

* Flexible work schedule to accommodate you and your customers’ needs
